```python
# runtime/server.py
#
# Zero-dependency local agent API server running on localhost:8000.
# Handles CORS and JSON routing to integrate the backend runtime with the VS Code extension.

import json
import os
import sys
from http.server import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

# Setup path so we can import from agent modules
AGENT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
if str(AGENT_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(AGENT_ROOT))

from runtime.runtime import Runtime
from runtime.editor.models import RuntimeContext, Diagnostic
from editing.symbol_handle import SymbolHandle
from editing.patch_applier import PatchApplier

class AgentHTTPHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    _runtime = None

    @classmethod
    def get_runtime(cls):
        if cls._runtime is None:
            cls._runtime = Runtime()
        return cls._runtime

    def _set_headers(self, status=200):
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "POST, GET, OPTIONS")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type")
        self.end_headers()

    def _set_sse_headers(self):
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
        self.send_header("Connection", "keep-alive")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "POST, GET, OPTIONS")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type")
        self.end_headers()

    def do_OPTIONS(self):
        self._set_headers(200)

    def do_POST(self):
        content_length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', 0))
        post_data = self.rfile.read(content_length).decode('utf-8')
        
        try:
            payload = json.loads(post_data) if post_data else {}
        except Exception as e:
            self._set_headers(400)
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps({"error": f"Invalid JSON payload: {e}"}).encode('utf-8'))
            return

        if self.path == "/chat":
            self.handle_chat(payload)
        elif self.path == "/retrieve":
            self.handle_retrieve(payload)
        elif self.path == "/modify":
            self.handle_modify(payload)
        elif self.path == "/apply_patch":
            self.handle_apply_patch(payload)
        elif self.path == "/diagnostics":
            self.handle_diagnostics(payload)
        else:
            self._set_headers(404)
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps({"error": "Endpoint not found"}).encode('utf-8'))

    def handle_chat(self, payload):
        query = payload.get("query")
        if not query:
            self._set_headers(400)
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps({"error": "Missing 'query' field"}).encode('utf-8'))
            return

        runtime = self.get_runtime()
        editor_context_json = payload.get("editor_context", {})
        
        # Map editor context
        runtime_ctx = self._map_editor_context(editor_context_json)
        
        self._set_sse_headers()

        def on_progress(event_type, content):
            data = json.dumps({"type": event_type, "content": content})
            try:
                self.wfile.write(f"data: {data}\n\n".encode('utf-8'))
                self.wfile.flush()
            except Exception:
                pass
        
        try:
            # We override state creation to attach the mapped runtime_context
            task_id = str(os.urandom(16).hex())
            state = runtime.state_manager.create_task(goal=query, task_id=task_id)
            state.runtime_context = runtime_ctx
            
            # Execute goal with progress stream
            runtime.run_goal(query, on_progress=on_progress)
            
            # Get latest plan & modifications
            plan = runtime.state_manager.get_execution_plan()
            
            response_data = {
                "status": "success",
                "task_id": task_id,
                "objective": plan.strategy.value if plan else "unknown",
                "stages": [
                    {
                        "name": stage.stage_id,
                        "tasks": [
                            {
                                "id": t.id,
                                "type": t.type.value,
                                "description": t.description,
                                "status": t.status.value
                            }
                            for tid in stage.parallel_tasks
                            for t in [plan.find_task(tid)]
                            if t is not None
                        ]
                    }
                    for stage in plan.stages
                ] if plan else []
            }
            on_progress("done", response_data)
        except Exception as e:
            try:
                import traceback
                traceback.print_exc()
                data = json.dumps({"type": "error", "content": f"Execution failed: {e}"})
                self.wfile.write(f"data: {data}\n\n".encode('utf-8'))
                self.wfile.flush()
            except Exception:
                pass

    def handle_retrieve(self, payload):
        query = payload.get("query")
        if not query:
            self._set_headers(400)
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps({"error": "Missing 'query' field"}).encode('utf-8'))
            return

        runtime = self.get_runtime()
        editor_context_json = payload.get("editor_context", {})
        runtime_ctx = self._map_editor_context(editor_context_json)

        try:
            from runtime.fast_path_router import FastPathRouter
            from context.context_builder import ContextBuilder
            
            route_decision = FastPathRouter.route(query, runtime_ctx)
            mode = route_decision.execution_mode
            
            # Build mock state to hold runtime context
            class MockState:
                def __init__(self, rc):
                    self.runtime_context = rc
                    self.session_id = "default"
                    self.open_files = []
            
            state = MockState(runtime_ctx)
            builder = ContextBuilder(runtime.executor.retrieval_pipeline, runtime.state_manager)
            pkg = builder.build_planning_context(query, state=state, mode=mode.value)
            
            # Serialize planning context
            response_data = {
                "goal": pkg.goal,
                "primary_symbol": self._serialize_symbol(pkg.primary_symbol),
                "callers": [self._serialize_symbol(c) for c in pkg.callers],
                "callees": [self._serialize_symbol(c) for c in pkg.callees],
                "related_tests": [self._serialize_symbol(t) for t in pkg.related_tests],
                "imports": pkg.imports,
                "snippets": [
                    {
                        "symbol": s.symbol,
                        "source": s.source,
                        "relevance": s.relevance
                    }
                    for s in pkg.snippets
                ]
            }
            self._set_headers(200)
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps(response_data).encode('utf-8'))
        except Exception as e:
            self._set_headers(500)
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps({"error": f"Retrieval failed: {e}"}).encode('utf-8'))

    def handle_modify(self, payload):
        query = payload.get("query")
        editor_context_json = payload.get("editor_context", {})
        
        runtime = self.get_runtime()
        runtime_ctx = self._map_editor_context(editor_context_json)

        self._set_sse_headers()

        def on_progress(event_type, content):
            data = json.dumps({"type": event_type, "content": content})
            try:
                self.wfile.write(f"data: {data}\n\n".encode('utf-8'))
                self.wfile.flush()
            except Exception:
                pass

        try:
            task_id = str(os.urandom(16).hex())
            state = runtime.state_manager.create_task(goal=query, task_id=task_id)
            state.runtime_context = runtime_ctx
            
            # Compile plan & run patch edits with progress stream
            runtime.run_goal(query, on_progress=on_progress)
            
            # Collect diffs
            pending = getattr(runtime.state_manager, "pending_patch", None)
            response_data = {
                "status": "success",
                "task_id": task_id,
                "patch": pending.get("patch") if pending else None,
                "file_path": pending.get("file_path") if pending else None
            }
            on_progress("done", response_data)
        except Exception as e:
            try:
                data = json.dumps({"type": "error", "content": f"Modification failed: {e}"})
                self.wfile.write(f"data: {data}\n\n".encode('utf-8'))
                self.wfile.flush()
            except Exception:
                pass

    def handle_apply_patch(self, payload):
        file_path = payload.get("file_path")
        patch = payload.get("patch")
        if not file_path or not patch:
            self._set_headers(400)
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps({"error": "Missing 'file_path' or 'patch' field"}).encode('utf-8'))
            return

        try:
            applier = PatchApplier()
            with open(file_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                content = f.read()
                
            try:
                new_content = applier.apply(content, patch)
                with open(file_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    f.write(new_content)
                self._set_headers(200)
                self.wfile.write(json.dumps({"status": "applied"}).encode('utf-8'))
            except ValueError as ve:
                self._set_headers(422)
                self.wfile.write(json.dumps({"error": str(ve)}).encode('utf-8'))
        except Exception as e:
            self._set_headers(500)
            import traceback
            traceback.print_exc()
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps({"error": f"Patch application error: {e}"}).encode('utf-8'))

    def handle_diagnostics(self, payload):
        # Simply cache diagnostics
        diagnostics_json = payload.get("diagnostics", [])
        from context.session_cache import SessionCache
        session_ctx = SessionCache.get_session("default")
        
        session_ctx.diagnostics = []
        for d in diagnostics_json:
            session_ctx.diagnostics.append(Diagnostic(
                file=d.get("file", ""),
                line=d.get("line", 0),
                severity=d.get("severity", "error"),
                message=d.get("message", ""),
                source=d.get("source", "")
            ))
        
        self._set_headers(200)
        self.wfile.write(json.dumps({"status": "registered", "count": len(session_ctx.diagnostics)}).encode('utf-8'))

    # Helper methods
    def _map_editor_context(self, ctx_json) -> RuntimeContext:
        if not ctx_json:
            return RuntimeContext()
            
        diagnostics = []
        for d in ctx_json.get("diagnostics", []):
            diagnostics.append(Diagnostic(
                file=d.get("file", ""),
                line=d.get("line", 0),
                severity=d.get("severity", ""),
                message=d.get("message", ""),
                source=d.get("source", "")
            ))
            
        cursor_pos = None
        if "cursor_line" in ctx_json:
            cursor_pos = (ctx_json["cursor_line"], ctx_json.get("cursor_column", 0))
            
        sel_range = None
        if "selection_range" in ctx_json:
            r = ctx_json["selection_range"]
            try:
                sel_range = ((r[0][0], r[0][1]), (r[1][0], r[1][1]))
            except Exception:
                pass

        return RuntimeContext(
            active_file=ctx_json.get("active_file"),
            cursor_position=cursor_pos,
            selection=ctx_json.get("selection"),
            selection_range=sel_range,
            open_tabs=ctx_json.get("open_tabs", []),
            diagnostics=diagnostics,
            visible_range=ctx_json.get("visible_range"),
            unsaved_buffer=ctx_json.get("unsaved_buffer")
        )

    def _serialize_symbol(self, handle: Optional[SymbolHandle]):
        if not handle:
            return None
        return {
            "symbol_id": handle.symbol_id,
            "fqn": handle.fqn,
            "kind": handle.kind,
            "file_path": handle.file_path,
            "start_line": handle.start_line,
            "end_line": handle.end_line
        }

def run_server(port=8000):
    server_address = ('', port)
    httpd = HTTPServer(server_address, AgentHTTPHandler)
    print(f"[AgentServer] Server running on port {port}...")
    try:
        httpd.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("[AgentServer] Stopping server...")
        httpd.server_close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    port = 8000
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        try:
            port = int(sys.argv[1])
        except ValueError:
            pass
    run_server(port)

```

```python
import re

# In tree-sitter 0.22+, Parser is constructed with the language:
#   _PARSER = Parser(_LANG)
# NOT:
#   _PARSER = Parser()
#   _PARSER.set_language(_LANG)

files = [
    r'd:\HRMS\.agent\parsers\java_parser.py',
    r'd:\HRMS\.agent\parsers\python_parser.py',
    r'd:\HRMS\.agent\parsers\js_parser.py',
    r'd:\HRMS\.agent\parsers\ts_parser.py',
]

for path in files:
    text = open(path, encoding='utf-8').read()
    original = text

    # Replace:  _PARSER = Parser()\n_PARSER.set_language(_LANG)
    # with:     _PARSER = Parser(_LANG)
    # (handles any var name: _PARSER, _TS_PARSER, _TSX_PARSER etc.)
    text = re.sub(
        r'(_\w*PARSER\w*)\s*=\s*Parser\(\)\s*\n\s*\1\.set_language\((_\w+)\)',
        r'\1 = Parser(\2)',
        text
    )
    if text != original:
        open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(text)
        print(f'  Fixed: {path.split(chr(92))[-1]}')
    else:
        print(f'  No match in: {path.split(chr(92))[-1]} (checking pattern manually)')
        # Show the relevant lines
        for line in text.splitlines():
            if 'Parser' in line or 'set_language' in line:
                print(f'    >> {line.strip()}')
```

```markdown
# implementation_plan.md — Database Layer Completion

## What exists (good foundation)
- `repositories`, `files`, `symbols` tables — fully populated (260 files, 707 symbols)
- Tree-sitter parsers (Java, Python, JS, TS) — working
- Scanner + symbol_indexer — working

## What is missing (5 things to build now)

### 1. Schema expansion
Add 5 tables:
- `symbol_relationships` — CALLS / IMPLEMENTS / EXTENDS / USES / TESTS edges
- `embeddings` — vector per symbol (384-dim MiniLM float array)
- `index_jobs` — incremental indexing audit log (what changed, when)
- `tests` — link test file → class/method under test
- `repair_patterns` — past LLM repair actions that worked (training signal)

### 2. Relationship indexer
`indexing/relationship_indexer.py`
- Reads Java AST: `implements`, `extends` → IMPLEMENTS / EXTENDS edges
- Reads import statements → USES edges (file level)
- Result: `symbol_relationships` table populated

### 3. Embedding indexer
`indexing/embedding_indexer.py`
- Embeds each symbol's signature + context using sentence-transformers MiniLM
- Stores float[] vector in `embeddings` table (as `REAL[]` or `TEXT` JSON)
- Skips already-embedded symbols (idempotent)

### 4. Incremental indexer
`indexing/incremental_indexer.py`
- On each run: compare current file hash vs stored hash
- Only re-parse + re-index files whose hash changed
- Records run in `index_jobs` table

### 5. Updated orchestrator
`index_repo.py` → runs all layers in order:
  scan → symbols → relationships → embeddings → incremental audit

```

```python
    print(f'Pattern (raw, name): FAIL - {e}')

# 0.22+ style - Language takes ptr directly
try:
    l = Language(raw)
    print('Pattern (raw,): OK')
except TypeError as e:
    print(f'Pattern (raw,): FAIL - {e}')

# Check if there is a ptr attribute
if hasattr(raw, 'ptr'):
    try:
        l = Language(raw.ptr, 'java')
        print('Pattern (raw.ptr, name): OK')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'Pattern (raw.ptr, name): FAIL - {e}')

# Try ctypes.addressof
try:
    import ctypes
    ptr = ctypes.cast(raw, ctypes.c_void_p).value
    l = Language(ptr, 'java')
    print('Pattern (ctypes ptr, name): OK')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'Pattern (ctypes ptr, name): FAIL - {e}')

# Try with the language ID method from 0.22
try:
    l = Language(ts_java.language_java())
    print('Pattern language_java(): OK')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'Pattern language_java(): FAIL - {e}')

# Check what methods ts_java has
print('ts_java attrs:', [a for a in dir(ts_java) if not a.startswith('_')])
```

```python
import sys, os, io, contextlib
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')
sys.path.insert(0, r'd:\HRMS\.agent')
os.chdir(r'd:\HRMS\.agent')

print('=== Unit tests (no indexing) ===')
print()

# 1. LLMPlanner parse - valid JSON
from llm.llm_planner import LLMPlanner
lp = LLMPlanner.__new__(LLMPlanner)
lp.llm = None

good = '{"task_type":"bug_fix","reasoning":"fix keyword","diagnosis":"null check missing","target_files":["EmployeeService.java"],"suggested_queries":["calculateSalary","deduction"]}'
r = lp._parse_response(good)
assert r['task_type'] == 'bug_fix', r
assert 'calculateSalary' in r['suggested_queries']
assert r['target_files'] == ['EmployeeService.java']
print('  OK  LLMPlanner._parse_response() valid JSON')

# 2. Markdown fences stripped
fenced = '```json\n{"task_type":"feature","reasoning":"add","diagnosis":"no endpoint","target_files":[],"suggested_queries":["leave"]}\n```'
r2 = lp._parse_response(fenced)
assert r2['task_type'] == 'feature'
print('  OK  LLMPlanner._parse_response() markdown fences stripped')

# 3. Invalid response -> None
r3 = lp._parse_response('sorry, I cannot answer that')
assert r3 is None
print('  OK  LLMPlanner._parse_response() None on bad JSON')

# 4. Unknown task_type normalised to analysis
r4 = lp._parse_response('{"task_type":"weird","diagnosis":"x","target_files":[],"suggested_queries":[]}')
assert r4['task_type'] == 'analysis'
print('  OK  LLMPlanner._parse_response() unknown type -> analysis')

# 5. DiffPrinter - basic diff
from runtime.diff_printer import DiffPrinter
dp = DiffPrinter()

orig = 'def calc():\n    return a - b\n'
mod  = 'def calc():\n    return a - (b or 0)\n'
buf = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
    dp.print_diff(orig, mod, 'calc.py', success=True)
out = buf.getvalue()
assert 'PATCH APPLIED' in out, 'missing PATCH APPLIED'
assert 'changed' in out, 'missing summary line'
print('  OK  DiffPrinter.print_diff() success case')

# 6. DiffPrinter - rollback
buf2 = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf2):
    dp.print_diff(orig, mod, 'calc.py', success=False)
assert 'ROLLED BACK' in buf2.getvalue()
print('  OK  DiffPrinter.print_diff() rollback case')

# 7. DiffPrinter - no change
buf3 = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf3):
    dp.print_diff(orig, orig, 'calc.py', success=True)
assert 'no changes' in buf3.getvalue()
print('  OK  DiffPrinter.print_diff() no-change case')

# 8. DiagnosticsReporter
from runtime.diagnostics import DiagnosticsReporter
dr = DiagnosticsReporter()
plan = {
    'task_type': 'bug_fix',
    'reasoning': 'test reason',
    'diagnosis': 'The method is missing a null check on deductions.',
    'target_files': ['EmployeeService.java', 'SalaryController.java'],
    'suggested_queries': ['calculateSalary', 'salary null'],
}
buf4 = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf4):
    dr.report('fix salary bug', plan, [])
out4 = buf4.getvalue()
assert 'AGENT DIAGNOSIS' in out4
assert 'BUG_FIX' in out4
assert 'EmployeeService.java' in out4
assert 'calculateSalary' in out4
assert 'null check' in out4
print('  OK  DiagnosticsReporter.report() full output')

# 9. announce_step
buf5 = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf5):
    dr.announce_step('modify_file', 'EmployeeService.java')
assert 'modify_file' in buf5.getvalue()
print('  OK  DiagnosticsReporter.announce_step()')

# 10. TaskState new fields
from memory.task_state import TaskState
ts = TaskState(goal='test')
assert hasattr(ts, 'task_type')
assert hasattr(ts, 'suggested_queries')
assert ts.task_type is None
assert ts.suggested_queries == []
ts.task_type = 'bug_fix'
ts.suggested_queries = ['salary', 'deduction']
assert ts.task_type == 'bug_fix'
print('  OK  TaskState.task_type + suggested_queries fields')

# 11. Planner uses LLM task_type
from planning.planner import Planner
p = Planner()
ts2 = TaskState(goal='do something unrecognised')
ts2.task_type = 'feature'
actions = p.create_plan(ts2)
action_types = [str(a.action_type if hasattr(a, 'action_type') else a.get('action_type','')) for a in actions]
print(f'  action_types for feature task: {action_types}')
assert any('retrieve' in t.lower() or 'modify' in t.lower() for t in action_types), \
    f'Expected feature actions, got: {action_types}'
print('  OK  Planner uses LLM task_type from state')

print()
print('ALL 11 UNIT TESTS PASSED')
```

```python
import sys
import os

# Ensure .agent is on path
agent_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
if agent_dir not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, agent_dir)

print(f"agent_dir: {agent_dir}")

print("Checking imports...")
try:
    from runtime.runtime import Runtime
    from llm.llm_planner import LLMPlanner
    from planning.planner import Planner
    print("[OK] All imports succeeded.")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"[FAIL] Import failed: {e}")
    import traceback
    traceback.print_exc()
    sys.exit(1)

print("Initializing Runtime...")
try:
    rt = Runtime()
    print("[OK] Runtime initialized successfully.")
    
    # Check that retrieval_pipeline is successfully exposed
    assert rt.retrieval_pipeline is not None, "retrieval_pipeline was not exposed on Runtime"
    print("[OK] retrieval_pipeline exposed on Runtime successfully.")
    
    # Check queries extraction
    queries = rt._extract_search_queries("Add logging to EmployeeService")
    print(f"[OK] Queries extracted successfully: {queries}")
    assert len(queries) > 0, "No queries extracted"
    
    # Check context package building
    dummy_chunk = {
        "file": "src/main/java/com/hrms/service/EmployeeService.java",
        "name": "calculateSalary",
        "type": "MethodDef",
        "code": "public void calculateSalary() {}"
    }
    context = rt._build_context_package([dummy_chunk])
    print(f"[OK] Context package built successfully: {context.keys()}")
    assert len(context["unique_files"]) == 1
    assert len(context["symbols"]) == 1
    
    # Verify planner doesn't fail to create a plan
    from memory.task_state import TaskState
    state = TaskState(goal="Add logging to EmployeeService", task_id="test_task_id")
    state.retrieved_chunks = [dummy_chunk]
    plan = rt.planner.create_plan(state)
    print(f"[OK] Planner created plan successfully (length {len(plan)}).")
    # Verify RETRIEVE actions are skipped when retrieved_chunks is set
    has_retrieve = any(action.action_type == "retrieve" for action in plan)
    print(f"   Skip retrieve check: has_retrieve = {has_retrieve}")
    assert not has_retrieve, "Planner failed to skip retrieve action when chunks already exist"
    print("[OK] Planner successfully skipped RETRIEVE actions because chunks were present.")
    
    print("\nALL PIPELINE VERIFICATIONS PASSED SUCCESSFULLY!")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"[FAIL] Verification failed: {e}")
    import traceback
    traceback.print_exc()
    sys.exit(1)
```

```python
import sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')
sys.path.insert(0, r'd:\HRMS\.agent')

from db.connection import get_conn

print('\n' + '='*60)
print('  VERIFICATION QUERIES')
print('='*60)

with get_conn() as conn:
    with conn.cursor() as cur:

        # ── Query 1: files table ──────────────────────────────
        print('\nQuery 1: SELECT * FROM files (first 10 rows)')
        print('-'*60)
        cur.execute("""
            SELECT id, relative_path, language, size_bytes, file_hash
            FROM   files
            ORDER  BY language, relative_path
            LIMIT  10
        """)
        rows = cur.fetchall()
        print(f"{'ID':<5} {'LANGUAGE':<12} {'SIZE':>7}  RELATIVE_PATH")
        print('-'*60)
        for row in rows:
            fid, rp, lang, size, fhash = row
            print(f"{fid:<5} {lang:<12} {size:>7}  {rp}")
        
        cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM files")
        total = cur.fetchone()[0]
        print(f"\n  Total: {total} files in table")

        # ── Query 2: find a symbol by name ────────────────────
        print('\nQuery 2: WHERE name LIKE createEmployee or similar')
        print('-'*60)
        cur.execute("""
            SELECT s.name, s.symbol_type, s.parent_name,
                   f.relative_path, s.line_start
            FROM   symbols s
            JOIN   files f ON s.file_id = f.id
            WHERE  s.name ILIKE '%employee%'
            ORDER  BY s.symbol_type, s.name
            LIMIT  15
        """)
        rows = cur.fetchall()
        print(f"{'NAME':<30} {'TYPE':<10} {'PARENT':<20} {'LINE':>5}  FILE")
        print('-'*60)
        for name, stype, parent, rp, line in rows:
            parent = parent or ''
            fname = rp.split('/')[-1] if rp else ''
            print(f"{name:<30} {stype:<10} {parent:<20} {str(line or ''):>5}  {fname}")

        # ── Query 3: all classes ──────────────────────────────
        print('\nQuery 3: symbol_type = CLASS')
        print('-'*60)
        cur.execute("""
            SELECT s.name, f.relative_path, s.line_start
            FROM   symbols s
            JOIN   files f ON s.file_id = f.id
            WHERE  s.symbol_type = 'CLASS'
            ORDER  BY s.name
            LIMIT  20
        """)
        rows = cur.fetchall()
        print(f"{'CLASS NAME':<35} {'LINE':>5}  FILE")
        print('-'*60)
        for name, rp, line in rows:
            fname = rp.split('/')[-1] if rp else ''
            print(f"{name:<35} {str(line or ''):>5}  {fname}")
        
        cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM symbols WHERE symbol_type='CLASS'")
        total_classes = cur.fetchone()[0]
        print(f'\n  Total classes: {total_classes}')

        # ── Query 4: all interfaces ───────────────────────────
        print('\nQuery 4: symbol_type = INTERFACE')
        print('-'*60)
        cur.execute("""
            SELECT s.name, f.relative_path, s.line_start
            FROM   symbols s
            JOIN   files f ON s.file_id = f.id
            WHERE  s.symbol_type = 'INTERFACE'
            ORDER  BY s.name
        """)
        rows = cur.fetchall()
        print(f"{'INTERFACE NAME':<35} {'LINE':>5}  FILE")
        print('-'*60)
        for name, rp, line in rows:
            fname = rp.split('/')[-1] if rp else ''
            print(f"{name:<35} {str(line or ''):>5}  {fname}")

print('\n' + '='*60)
print('  All 3 milestone queries PASSED')
print('='*60)
```

```json
            "code": "package com.acme.hrms.salary.dto;\n\nimport java.math.BigDecimal;\nimport java.time.LocalDate;\nimport java.util.UUID;\n\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.DecimalMin;\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull;\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.Size;\n\npublic record SalaryCreateRequest(\n        @NotNull UUID employeeId,\n        @NotNull @DecimalMin(value = \"0.0001\") BigDecimal amount,\n        @NotNull @Size(min = 3, max = 3) String currencyCode,\n        @NotNull LocalDate effectiveFrom,\n        LocalDate effectiveTo,\n        @Size(max = 1024) String reason\n) {\n}"
          }
        },

            "code": "import { api } from '@/lib/api/client';\nimport type { SpringPage } from '@/lib/api/types';\n\nexport type Salary = { id: string; employeeId: string; amount: number; currencyCode: string; effectiveFrom: string; effectiveTo: string | null; reason: string | null; createdAt: string };\nexport type DocumentRecord = { id: string; employeeId: string; documentType: string; restricted: boolean; sharable: boolean; originalFilename: string; contentType: string; sizeBytes: number | null; uploadStatus: string; createdAt: string };\nexport type AuditEntry = { id: string; at: string; actorId: string | null; actorLabel: string | null; action: string; entity: string; entityId: string | null; requestId: string | null; detail: string | null };\n\nexport const operationsApi = {\n  salaryMe: () => api.get<Salary[]>('/api/salaries/me'),\n  salaryForEmployee: (employeeId: string) => api.get<Salary[]>(`/api/salaries/employee/${employeeId}`),\n  createSalary: (body: { employeeId: string; amount: number; currencyCode: string; effectiveFrom: string; effectiveTo?: string; reason?: string }) => api.post<Salary>('/api/salaries', body),\n\n  documentsForEmployee: (employeeId: string) => api.get<DocumentRecord[]>(`/api/documents/employee/${employeeId}`),\n  presignUpload: (body: { employeeId: string; documentType: string; contentType: string; originalFilename: string; sharable: boolean }) => api.post<{ documentId: string; uploadUrl: string; httpMethod: string; storageKey: string }>('/api/documents/presign-upload', body),\n  completeUpload: (documentId: string, sizeBytes: number) => api.post<DocumentRecord>(`/api/documents/${documentId}/complete`, { sizeBytes }),\n  presignDownload: (documentId: string) => api.get<{ documentId: string; downloadUrl: string; httpMethod: string }>(`/api/documents/${documentId}/presign-download`),\n  deleteDocument: (documentId: string) => api.delete<void>(`/api/documents/${documentId}`),\n\n  auditLogs: (page: number, size: number) => api.get<SpringPage<AuditEntry>>(`/api/audit-logs?page=${page}&size=${size}&sort=at,desc`),\n};"
          }
        },

      "code": "import { api } from '@/lib/api/client';\nimport type { SpringPage } from '@/lib/api/types';\n\nexport type Salary = { id: string; employeeId: string; amount: number; currencyCode: string; effectiveFrom: string; effectiveTo: string | null; reason: string | null; createdAt: string };\nexport type DocumentRecord = { id: string; employeeId: string; documentType: string; restricted: boolean; sharable: boolean; originalFilename: string; contentType: string; sizeBytes: number | null; uploadStatus: string; createdAt: string };\nexport type AuditEntry = { id: string; at: string; actorId: string | null; actorLabel: string | null; action: string; entity: string; entityId: string | null; requestId: string | null; detail: string | null };\n\nexport const operationsApi = {\n  salaryMe: () => api.get<Salary[]>('/api/salaries/me'),\n  salaryForEmployee: (employeeId: string) => api.get<Salary[]>(`/api/salaries/employee/${employeeId}`),\n  createSalary: (body: { employeeId: string; amount: number; currencyCode: string; effectiveFrom: string; effectiveTo?: string; reason?: string }) => api.post<Salary>('/api/salaries', body),\n\n  documentsForEmployee: (employeeId: string) => api.get<DocumentRecord[]>(`/api/documents/employee/${employeeId}`),\n  presignUpload: (body: { employeeId: string; documentType: string; contentType: string; originalFilename: string; sharable: boolean }) => api.post<{ documentId: string; uploadUrl: string; httpMethod: string; storageKey: string }>('/api/documents/presign-upload', body),\n  completeUpload: (documentId: string, sizeBytes: number) => api.post<DocumentRecord>(`/api/documents/${documentId}/complete`, { sizeBytes }),\n  presignDownload: (documentId: string) => api.get<{ documentId: string; downloadUrl: string; httpMethod: string }>(`/api/documents/${documentId}/presign-download`),\n  deleteDocument: (documentId: string) => api.delete<void>(`/api/documents/${documentId}`),\n\n  auditLogs: (page: number, size: number) => api.get<SpringPage<AuditEntry>>(`/api/audit-logs?page=${page}&size=${size}&sort=at,desc`),\n};"
    },

            "code": "package com.acme.hrms.salary.dto;\n\nimport java.math.BigDecimal;\nimport java.time.LocalDate;\nimport java.util.UUID;\n\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.DecimalMin;\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull;\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.Size;\n\npublic record SalaryCreateRequest(\n        @NotNull UUID employeeId,\n        @NotNull @DecimalMin(value = \"0.0001\") BigDecimal amount,\n        @NotNull @Size(min = 3, max = 3) String currencyCode,\n        @NotNull LocalDate effectiveFrom,\n        LocalDate effectiveTo,\n        @Size(max = 1024) String reason\n) {\n}"
          }

            "code": "import { api } from '@/lib/api/client';\nimport type { SpringPage } from '@/lib/api/types';\n\nexport type Salary = { id: string; employeeId: string; amount: number; currencyCode: string; effectiveFrom: string; effectiveTo: string | null; reason: string | null; createdAt: string };\nexport type DocumentRecord = { id: string; employeeId: string; documentType: string; restricted: boolean; sharable: boolean; originalFilename: string; contentType: string; sizeBytes: number | null; uploadStatus: string; createdAt: string };\nexport type AuditEntry = { id: string; at: string; actorId: string | null; actorLabel: string | null; action: string; entity: string; entityId: string | null; requestId: string | null; detail: string | null };\n\nexport const operationsApi = {\n  salaryMe: () => api.get<Salary[]>('/api/salaries/me'),\n  salaryForEmployee: (employeeId: string) => api.get<Salary[]>(`/api/salaries/employee/${employeeId}`),\n  createSalary: (body: { employeeId: string; amount: number; currencyCode: string; effectiveFrom: string; effectiveTo?: string; reason?: string }) => api.post<Salary>('/api/salaries', body),\n\n  documentsForEmployee: (employeeId: string) => api.get<DocumentRecord[]>(`/api/documents/employee/${employeeId}`),\n  presignUpload: (body: { employeeId: string; documentType: string; contentType: string; originalFilename: string; sharable: boolean }) => api.post<{ documentId: string; uploadUrl: string; httpMethod: string; storageKey: string }>('/api/documents/presign-upload', body),\n  completeUpload: (documentId: string, sizeBytes: number) => api.post<DocumentRecord>(`/api/documents/${documentId}/complete`, { sizeBytes }),\n  presignDownload: (documentId: string) => api.get<{ documentId: string; downloadUrl: string; httpMethod: string }>(`/api/documents/${documentId}/presign-download`),\n  deleteDocument: (documentId: string) => api.delete<void>(`/api/documents/${documentId}`),\n\n  auditLogs: (page: number, size: number) => api.get<SpringPage<AuditEntry>>(`/api/audit-logs?page=${page}&size=${size}&sort=at,desc`),\n};"
          }
        },
```

```json
            "code": "import { api } from '@/lib/api/client';\nimport type { SpringPage } from '@/lib/api/types';\n\nexport type Salary = { id: string; employeeId: string; amount: number; currencyCode: string; effectiveFrom: string; effectiveTo: string | null; reason: string | null; createdAt: string };\nexport type DocumentRecord = { id: string; employeeId: string; documentType: string; restricted: boolean; sharable: boolean; originalFilename: string; contentType: string; sizeBytes: number | null; uploadStatus: string; createdAt: string };\nexport type AuditEntry = { id: string; at: string; actorId: string | null; actorLabel: string | null; action: string; entity: string; entityId: string | null; requestId: string | null; detail: string | null };\n\nexport const operationsApi = {\n  salaryMe: () => api.get<Salary[]>('/api/salaries/me'),\n  salaryForEmployee: (employeeId: string) => api.get<Salary[]>(`/api/salaries/employee/${employeeId}`),\n  createSalary: (body: { employeeId: string; amount: number; currencyCode: string; effectiveFrom: string; effectiveTo?: string; reason?: string }) => api.post<Salary>('/api/salaries', body),\n\n  documentsForEmployee: (employeeId: string) => api.get<DocumentRecord[]>(`/api/documents/employee/${employeeId}`),\n  presignUpload: (body: { employeeId: string; documentType: string; contentType: string; originalFilename: string; sharable: boolean }) => api.post<{ documentId: string; uploadUrl: string; httpMethod: string; storageKey: string }>('/api/documents/presign-upload', body),\n  completeUpload: (documentId: string, sizeBytes: number) => api.post<DocumentRecord>(`/api/documents/${documentId}/complete`, { sizeBytes }),\n  presignDownload: (documentId: string) => api.get<{ documentId: string; downloadUrl: string; httpMethod: string }>(`/api/documents/${documentId}/presign-download`),\n  deleteDocument: (documentId: string) => api.delete<void>(`/api/documents/${documentId}`),\n\n  auditLogs: (page: number, size: number) => api.get<SpringPage<AuditEntry>>(`/api/audit-logs?page=${page}&size=${size}&sort=at,desc`),\n};"
          }
        },

      "code": "package com.acme.hrms.salary.dto;\n\nimport java.math.BigDecimal;\nimport java.time.LocalDate;\nimport java.util.UUID;\n\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.DecimalMin;\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull;\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.Size;\n\npublic record SalaryCreateRequest(\n        @NotNull UUID employeeId,\n        @NotNull @DecimalMin(value = \"0.0001\") BigDecimal amount,\n        @NotNull @Size(min = 3, max = 3) String currencyCode,\n        @NotNull LocalDate effectiveFrom,\n        LocalDate effectiveTo,\n        @Size(max = 1024) String reason\n) {\n}"
    },

      "start_line": 1,
      "end_line": 20,
      "parent": null,
      "docstring": "",
      "imports": [
        "@/lib/api/client",
        "@/lib/api/types"
      ],
      "chunk_index": 0,
      "total_chunks": 1,
      "code": "import { api } from '@/lib/api/client';\nimport type { SpringPage } from '@/lib/api/types';\n\nexport type Salary = { id: string; employeeId: string; amount: number; currencyCode: string; effectiveFrom: string; effectiveTo: string | null; reason: string | null; createdAt: string };\nexport type DocumentRecord = { id: string; employeeId: string; documentType: string; restricted: boolean; sharable: boolean; originalFilename: string; contentType: string; sizeBytes: number | null; uploadStatus: string; createdAt: string };\nexport type AuditEntry = { id: string; at: string; actorId: string | null; actorLabel: string | null; action: string; entity: string; entityId: string | null; requestId: string | null; detail: string | null };\n\nexport const operationsApi = {\n  salaryMe: () => api.get<Salary[]>('/api/salaries/me'),\n  salaryForEmployee: (employeeId: string) => api.get<Salary[]>(`/api/salaries/employee/${employeeId}`),\n  createSalary: (body: { employeeId: string; amount: number; currencyCode: string; effectiveFrom: string; effectiveTo?: string; reason?: string }) => api.post<Salary>('/api/salaries', body),\n\n  documentsForEmployee: (employeeId: string) => api.get<DocumentRecord[]>(`/api/documents/employee/${employeeId}`),\n  presignUpload: (body: { employeeId: string; documentType: string; contentType: string; originalFilename: string; sharable: boolean }) => api.post<{ documentId: string; uploadUrl: string; httpMethod: string; storageKey: string }>('/api/documents/presign-upload', body),\n  completeUpload: (documentId: string, sizeBytes: number) => api.post<DocumentRecord>(`/api/documents/${documentId}/complete`, { sizeBytes }),\n  presignDownload: (documentId: string) => api.get<{ documentId: string; downloadUrl: string; httpMethod: string }>(`/api/documents/${documentId}/presign-download`),\n  deleteDocument: (documentId: string) => api.delete<void>(`/api/documents/${documentId}`),\n\n  auditLogs: (page: number, size: number) => api.get<SpringPage<AuditEntry>>(`/api/audit-logs?page=${page}&size=${size}&sort=at,desc`),\n};"
    },

            "code": "package com.acme.hrms.salary.dto;\n\nimport java.math.BigDecimal;\nimport java.time.LocalDate;\nimport java.util.UUID;\n\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.DecimalMin;\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull;\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.Size;\n\npublic record SalaryCreateRequest(\n        @NotNull UUID employeeId,\n        @NotNull @DecimalMin(value = \"0.0001\") BigDecimal amount,\n        @NotNull @Size(min = 3, max = 3) String currencyCode,\n        @NotNull LocalDate effectiveFrom,\n        LocalDate effectiveTo,\n        @Size(max = 1024) String reason\n) {\n}"
          }
        },

            "code": "import { api } from '@/lib/api/client';\nimport type { SpringPage } from '@/lib/api/types';\n\nexport type Salary = { id: string; employeeId: string; amount: number; currencyCode: string; effectiveFrom: string; effectiveTo: string | null; reason: string | null; createdAt: string };\nexport type DocumentRecord = { id: string; employeeId: string; documentType: string; restricted: boolean; sharable: boolean; originalFilename: string; contentType: string; sizeBytes: number | null; uploadStatus: string; createdAt: string };\nexport type AuditEntry = { id: string; at: string; actorId: string | null; actorLabel: string | null; action: string; entity: string; entityId: string | null; requestId: string | null; detail: string | null };\n\nexport const operationsApi = {\n  salaryMe: () => api.get<Salary[]>('/api/salaries/me'),\n  salaryForEmployee: (employeeId: string) => api.get<Salary[]>(`/api/salaries/employee/${employeeId}`),\n  createSalary: (body: { employeeId: string; amount: number; currencyCode: string; effectiveFrom: string; effectiveTo?: string; reason?: string }) => api.post<Salary>('/api/salaries', body),\n\n  documentsForEmployee: (employeeId: string) => api.get<DocumentRecord[]>(`/api/documents/employee/${employeeId}`),\n  presignUpload: (body: { employeeId: string; documentType: string; contentType: string; originalFilename: string; sharable: boolean }) => api.post<{ documentId: string; uploadUrl: string; httpMethod: string; storageKey: string }>('/api/documents/presign-upload', body),\n  completeUpload: (documentId: string, sizeBytes: number) => api.post<DocumentRecord>(`/api/documents/${documentId}/complete`, { sizeBytes }),\n  presignDownload: (documentId: string) => api.get<{ documentId: string; downloadUrl: string; httpMethod: string }>(`/api/documents/${documentId}/presign-download`),\n  deleteDocument: (documentId: string) => api.delete<void>(`/api/documents/${documentId}`),\n\n  auditLogs: (page: number, size: number) => api.get<SpringPage<AuditEntry>>(`/api/audit-logs?page=${page}&size=${size}&sort=at,desc`),\n};"
          }
        },
```

```json
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "code": "    def _summarise_failures(self, failures: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Short human-readable summary of failures for action titles.\"\"\"\n        parts = []\n        for f in failures[:3]:\n            error_type = f.get(\"error_type\", \"\")\n            message = f.get(\"message\", \"\")\n            if error_type and message:\n                parts.append(f\"{error_type}: {message[:60]}\")\n            elif message:\n                parts.append(message[:60])\n        return \"; \".join(parts) if parts else \"test failure\"",

            "code": "    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])",

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "chunk_index": 0,
            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "code": "    def _summarise_failures(self, failures: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Short human-readable summary of failures for action titles.\"\"\"\n        parts = []\n        for f in failures[:3]:\n            error_type = f.get(\"error_type\", \"\")\n            message = f.get(\"message\", \"\")\n            if error_type and message:\n                parts.append(f\"{error_type}: {message[:60]}\")\n            elif message:\n                parts.append(message[:60])\n        return \"; \".join(parts) if parts else \"test failure\"",

            "chunk_index": 0,
            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "chunk_index": 0,
            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "code": "    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "chunk_index": 0,
            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "code": "    def _summarise_failures(self, failures: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Short human-readable summary of failures for action titles.\"\"\"\n        parts = []\n        for f in failures[:3]:\n            error_type = f.get(\"error_type\", \"\")\n            message = f.get(\"message\", \"\")\n            if error_type and message:\n                parts.append(f\"{error_type}: {message[:60]}\")\n            elif message:\n                parts.append(message[:60])\n        return \"; \".join(parts) if parts else \"test failure\"",

            "chunk_index": 0,
            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "code": "    def _summarise_failures(self, failures: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Short human-readable summary of failures for action titles.\"\"\"\n        parts = []\n        for f in failures[:3]:\n            error_type = f.get(\"error_type\", \"\")\n            message = f.get(\"message\", \"\")\n            if error_type and message:\n                parts.append(f\"{error_type}: {message[:60]}\")\n            elif message:\n                parts.append(message[:60])\n        return \"; \".join(parts) if parts else \"test failure\"",

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "chunk_index": 0,
            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "code": "    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "code": "    def _summarise_failures(self, failures: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Short human-readable summary of failures for action titles.\"\"\"\n        parts = []\n        for f in failures[:3]:\n            error_type = f.get(\"error_type\", \"\")\n            message = f.get(\"message\", \"\")\n            if error_type and message:\n                parts.append(f\"{error_type}: {message[:60]}\")\n            elif message:\n                parts.append(message[:60])\n        return \"; \".join(parts) if parts else \"test failure\"",

            "code": "    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])",

      "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

      "code": "    def _summarise_failures(self, failures: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Short human-readable summary of failures for action titles.\"\"\"\n        parts = []\n        for f in failures[:3]:\n            error_type = f.get(\"error_type\", \"\")\n            message = f.get(\"message\", \"\")\n            if error_type and message:\n                parts.append(f\"{error_type}: {message[:60]}\")\n            elif message:\n                parts.append(message[:60])\n        return \"; \".join(parts) if parts else \"test failure\"",

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",
```
