            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "chunk_index": 0,
            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "code": "    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "chunk_index": 0,
            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "code": "    def _summarise_failures(self, failures: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Short human-readable summary of failures for action titles.\"\"\"\n        parts = []\n        for f in failures[:3]:\n            error_type = f.get(\"error_type\", \"\")\n            message = f.get(\"message\", \"\")\n            if error_type and message:\n                parts.append(f\"{error_type}: {message[:60]}\")\n            elif message:\n                parts.append(message[:60])\n        return \"; \".join(parts) if parts else \"test failure\"",

            "chunk_index": 0,
            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "code": "    def _summarise_failures(self, failures: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Short human-readable summary of failures for action titles.\"\"\"\n        parts = []\n        for f in failures[:3]:\n            error_type = f.get(\"error_type\", \"\")\n            message = f.get(\"message\", \"\")\n            if error_type and message:\n                parts.append(f\"{error_type}: {message[:60]}\")\n            elif message:\n                parts.append(message[:60])\n        return \"; \".join(parts) if parts else \"test failure\"",

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "chunk_index": 0,
            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "code": "    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "chunk_index": 0,
            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "code": "    def _summarise_failures(self, failures: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Short human-readable summary of failures for action titles.\"\"\"\n        parts = []\n        for f in failures[:3]:\n            error_type = f.get(\"error_type\", \"\")\n            message = f.get(\"message\", \"\")\n            if error_type and message:\n                parts.append(f\"{error_type}: {message[:60]}\")\n            elif message:\n                parts.append(message[:60])\n        return \"; \".join(parts) if parts else \"test failure\"",

            "chunk_index": 0,
            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "code": "    def _summarise_failures(self, failures: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Short human-readable summary of failures for action titles.\"\"\"\n        parts = []\n        for f in failures[:3]:\n            error_type = f.get(\"error_type\", \"\")\n            message = f.get(\"message\", \"\")\n            if error_type and message:\n                parts.append(f\"{error_type}: {message[:60]}\")\n            elif message:\n                parts.append(message[:60])\n        return \"; \".join(parts) if parts else \"test failure\"",

            "chunk_index": 0,
            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

      "total_chunks": 1,
      "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

      "code": "    def _summarise_failures(self, failures: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Short human-readable summary of failures for action titles.\"\"\"\n        parts = []\n        for f in failures[:3]:\n            error_type = f.get(\"error_type\", \"\")\n            message = f.get(\"message\", \"\")\n            if error_type and message:\n                parts.append(f\"{error_type}: {message[:60]}\")\n            elif message:\n                parts.append(message[:60])\n        return \"; \".join(parts) if parts else \"test failure\"",

            "chunk_index": 0,
            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "code": "    def _summarise_failures(self, failures: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Short human-readable summary of failures for action titles.\"\"\"\n        parts = []\n        for f in failures[:3]:\n            error_type = f.get(\"error_type\", \"\")\n            message = f.get(\"message\", \"\")\n            if error_type and message:\n                parts.append(f\"{error_type}: {message[:60]}\")\n            elif message:\n                parts.append(message[:60])\n        return \"; \".join(parts) if parts else \"test failure\"",

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

(from realm role {@code HR_ADMIN})</li>\n *   <li>{@code SCOPE_profile}      (from OAuth2 scope, kept for diagnostics)</li>\n * </ul>\n *\n * <p>The principal name is the {@code preferred_username} claim if present,\n * else {@code email}, else {@code sub}.\n */\npublic final class JwtRoleConverter implements Converter<Jwt, AbstractAuthenticationToken> {\n\n    private static final String CLAIM_REALM_ACCESS = \"realm_access\";\n    private static final String CLAIM_ROLES = \"roles\";\n\n    private final JwtGrantedAuthoritiesConverter scopeConverter = new JwtGrantedAuthoritiesConverter();\n\n    @Override\n    public AbstractAuthenticationToken convert(Jwt jwt) {\n        Collection<GrantedAuthority> authorities = new ArrayList<>(scopeConverter.convert(jwt));\n        authorities.addAll(extractRealmRoles(jwt));\n        String principalName = resolvePrincipalName(jwt);\n        return new JwtAuthenticationToken(jwt, authorities, principalName);\n    }\n\n    private Set<GrantedAuthority> extractRealmRoles(Jwt jwt) {\n        Map<String, Object> realmAccess = instanceof List<?> rawRoles)) {\n            return Set.of();\n        }\n        Set<GrantedAuthority> result = new HashSet<>();\n        for (Object role : rawRoles) {\n            if (role instanceof String s && !s.isBlank()) {\n                result.add(new SimpleGrantedAuthority(Roles.AUTHORITY_PREFIX + s));\n            }\n        }\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    private static String resolvePrincipalName(Jwt jwt) {\n        String preferred = jwt.getClaimAsString(\"preferred_username\");\n        if (preferred != null && !preferred.isBlank()) {\n            return preferred;\n        }\n        String email = jwt.getClaimAsString(\"email\");\n        if (email != null && !email.isBlank()) {\n            return email;\n        }\n        return jwt.getSubject();\n    }\n"

org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;\n\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.audit.AuditAction;\nimport io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;\nimport io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;\n\n/**\n * Identity probe.\n *\n * <p>Used by the SPA right after login to render the current user's name +\n * <p>Each successful call writes one {@link AuditAction#LOGIN} row, which\n * is enough to demonstrate the audit pipeline end-to-end without lighting\n * up audit on every request (we'll do that explicitly per feature later).\n */\n@RestController\n@RequestMapping(\"/api/me\")\n@Tag(name = \"Me\", description = \"Current user identity\")\npublic class MeController {\n\n    private final AuditService auditService;\n\n    public MeController(AuditService auditService) {\n        this.auditService = auditService;\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping\n    @Operation(summary = \"Return the identity }\n}"

            "code": "package com.acme.hrms.common.security;\n\nimport java.util.Optional;\nimport java.util.Set;\nimport java.util.UUID;\n\nimport org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;\nimport org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;\nimport org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;\nimport org.springframework.security.oauth2.server.resource.authentication.JwtAuthenticationToken;\n\n/**\n * Snapshot of the caller built from the validated JWT.\n *\n * <p>Pass this through to services that need to make authorisation decisions\n * or write {@code created_by} / {@code updated_by} columns. Never read the\n * {@link SecurityContextHolder} from inside services — take a {@code CurrentUser}\n * argument instead, both for testability and to make the contract explicit.\n *\n * <p>The {@code subjectUuid} field is the Keycloak user id, which we mirror\n * into {@code employee.keycloak_user_id} once the employee module lands.\n */\npublic record CurrentUser(\n        UUID subjectUuid,\n        String username,\n        String email,\n        Set<String> roles\n) {\n\n    public boolean hasRole(String role) {\n        return roles.contains(role);\n    }\n\n    public boolean hasAnyRole(String... candidates) {\n        for (String r : candidates) {\n            if (roles.contains(r)) {\n                return true;\n            }\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Resolve the current user from the security context, if any. Returns\n     * empty for anonymous / unauthenticated requests.\n     */\n    public static Optional<CurrentUser> fromSecurityContext() {\n        Authentication auth = SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();\n        if (!(auth instanceof JwtAuthenticationToken token)) {\n            return Optional.empty();\n        }\n        return Optional.of(from(token.getToken()));\n    }\n\n    public static CurrentUser from(Jwt jwt) {\n        UUID subject = parseSubjectAsUuid(jwt.getSubject());\n        String username = jwt.getClaimAsString(\"preferred_username\");\n        String email = jwt.getClaimAsString(\"email\");\n        Set<String> roles = JwtRoleConverter.rolesOf(jwt);\n        return new CurrentUser(subject, username, email, roles);\n    }\n\n    private static UUID parseSubjectAsUuid(String subject) {\n        if (subject == null || subject.isBlank()) {\n            return null;\n        }\n        try {\n            return UUID.fromString(subject);\n        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {\n            // Keycloak issues UUID subjects, but a non-UUID 'sub' (e.g. for a\n            // service account or external IdP) shouldn't blow up auth.\n            return null;\n        }\n    }\n}"

            "code": "package com.acme.hrms.common.security;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.Collection;\nimport java.util.HashSet;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\nimport java.util.Set;\nimport java.util.stream.Collectors;\n\nimport org.springframework.core.convert.converter.Converter;\nimport org.springframework.security.authentication.AbstractAuthenticationToken;\nimport org.springframework.security.core.GrantedAuthority;\nimport org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority;\nimport org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;\nimport org.springframework.security.oauth2.server.resource.authentication.JwtAuthenticationToken;\nimport org.springframework.security.oauth2.server.resource.authentication.JwtGrantedAuthoritiesConverter;\n\n/**\n * Translates a Keycloak access token into a Spring {@link AbstractAuthenticationToken}\n * with the right authorities for our RBAC matrix.\n *\n * <p>Keycloak places realm roles inside {@code realm_access.roles}. Spring\n * Security's default converter only picks up {@code scope}/{@code scp}, so\n * we extend it manually.\n *\n * <p>Authorities produced look like:\n * <ul>\n *   <li>{@code ROLE_HR_ADMIN}      (from realm role {@code HR_ADMIN})</li>\n *   <li>{@code SCOPE_profile}      (from OAuth2 scope, kept for diagnostics)</li>\n * </ul>\n *\n * <p>The principal name is the {@code preferred_username} claim if present,\n * else {@code email}, else {@code sub}.\n */\npublic final class JwtRoleConverter implements Converter<Jwt, AbstractAuthenticationToken> {\n\n    private static final String CLAIM_REALM_ACCESS = \"realm_access\";\n    private static final String CLAIM_ROLES = \"roles\";\n\n    private final JwtGrantedAuthoritiesConverter scopeConverter = new JwtGrantedAuthoritiesConverter();\n\n    @Override\n    public AbstractAuthenticationToken convert(Jwt jwt) {\n        Collection<GrantedAuthority> authorities = new ArrayList<>(scopeConverter.convert(jwt));\n        authorities.addAll(extractRealmRoles(jwt));\n        String principalName = resolvePrincipalName(jwt);\n        return new JwtAuthenticationToken(jwt, authorities, principalName);\n    }\n\n    private Set<GrantedAuthority> extractRealmRoles(Jwt jwt) {\n        Map<String, Object> realmAccess = jwt.getClaimAsMap(CLAIM_REALM_ACCESS);\n        if (realmAccess == null) {\n            return Set.of();\n        }\n        Object rolesObj = realmAccess.get(CLAIM_ROLES);\n        if (!(rolesObj instanceof List<?> rawRoles)) {\n            return Set.of();\n        }\n        Set<GrantedAuthority> result = new HashSet<>();\n        for (Object role : rawRoles) {\n            if (role instanceof String s && !s.isBlank()) {\n                result.add(new SimpleGrantedAuthority(Roles.AUTHORITY_PREFIX + s));\n            }\n        }\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    private static String resolvePrincipalName(Jwt jwt) {\n        String preferred = jwt.getClaimAsString(\"preferred_username\");\n        if (preferred != null && !preferred.isBlank()) {\n            return preferred;\n        }\n        String email = jwt.getClaimAsString(\"email\");\n        if (email != null && !email.isBlank()) {\n            return email;\n        }\n        return jwt.getSubject();\n    }\n"

Useful from {@link CurrentUser}.\n     */\n    public static Set<String> rolesOf(Jwt jwt) {\n        Map<String, Object> realmAccess = jwt.getClaimAsMap(CLAIM_REALM_ACCESS);\n        if (realmAccess == null) {\n            return Set.of();\n        }\n        Object rolesObj = realmAccess.get(CLAIM_ROLES);\n        if (!(rolesObj instanceof List<?> rawRoles)) {\n            return Set.of();\n        }\n        return rawRoles.stream()\n                .filter(String.class::isInstance)\n                .map(String.class::cast)\n                .filter(s -> !s.isBlank())\n                .collect(Collectors.toUnmodifiableSet());\n    }\n}"

            "code": "package com.acme.hrms.me;\n\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.TreeSet;\n\nimport org.slf4j.MDC;\nimport org.springframework.security.core.annotation.AuthenticationPrincipal;\nimport org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;\n\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.audit.AuditAction;\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.audit.AuditEvent;\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.audit.AuditService;\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.security.CurrentUser;\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.web.RequestIdFilter;\n\nimport io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;\nimport io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;\n\n/**\n * Identity probe.\n *\n * <p>Used by the SPA right after login to render the current user's name +\n * roles in the navbar without needing to decode the token client-side.\n * Also doubles as a smoke-test endpoint: if {@code /api/me} returns 200\n * with the right roles, auth wiring works.\n *\n * <p>Each successful call writes one {@link AuditAction#LOGIN} row, which\n * is enough to demonstrate the audit pipeline end-to-end without lighting\n * up audit on every request (we'll do that explicitly per feature later).\n */\n@RestController\n@RequestMapping(\"/api/me\")\n@Tag(name = \"Me\", description = \"Current user identity\")\npublic class MeController {\n\n    private final AuditService auditService;\n\n    public MeController(AuditService auditService) {\n        this.auditService = auditService;\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping\n    @Operation(summary = \"Return the identity and realm roles of the caller\")\n    public MeResponse me(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {\n        CurrentUser user = CurrentUser.from(jwt);\n        List<String> sortedRoles = List.copyOf(new TreeSet<>(user.roles()));\n\n        auditService.record(\n                AuditEvent.of(AuditAction.LOGIN, \"session\")\n                        .withDetail(\"GET /api/me\"));\n\n        return new MeResponse(\n                user.subjectUuid(),\n                user.username(),\n                user.email(),\n                sortedRoles,\n                MDC.get(RequestIdFilter.MDC_KEY));\n    }\n}"
          }

            "chunk_index": 0,
            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "package com.acme.hrms.support;\n\nimport java.util.Arrays;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\nimport java.util.UUID;\n\nimport org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority;\nimport org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;\nimport org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.RequestPostProcessor;\n\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.security.Roles;\n\nimport static org.springframework.security.test.web.servlet.request.SecurityMockMvcRequestPostProcessors.jwt;\n\n/**\n * Helpers for issuing test bearer tokens with specific subject + roles.\n *\n * <p>Centralised so individual tests don't repeat the JWT-builder dance.\n * Always passes the same claims a real Keycloak token would carry:\n * {@code sub}, {@code preferred_username}, {@code email}, and the\n * {@code realm_access.roles} array.\n */\npublic final class JwtTestSupport {\n\n    private JwtTestSupport() {\n    }\n\n    public static RequestPostProcessor asUser(UUID subject, String username, String... roles) {\n        List<String> roleList = Arrays.asList(roles);\n        SimpleGrantedAuthority[] authorities = roleList.stream()\n                .map(r -> new SimpleGrantedAuthority(Roles.AUTHORITY_PREFIX + r))\n                .toArray(SimpleGrantedAuthority[]::new);\n        return jwt()\n                .jwt(builder -> applyClaims(builder, subject, username, roleList))\n                .authorities(authorities);\n    }\n\n    private static void applyClaims(Jwt.Builder builder, UUID subject, String username, List<String> roles) {\n        builder.subject(subject.toString())\n                .claim(\"preferred_username\", username)\n                .claim(\"email\", username)\n                .claim(\"realm_access\", Map.of(\"roles\", roles));\n    }\n}"
          }
        }

            "code": "package com.acme.hrms.common.security;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.Collection;\nimport java.util.HashSet;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\nimport java.util.Set;\nimport java.util.stream.Collectors;\n\nimport org.springframework.core.convert.converter.Converter;\nimport org.springframework.security.authentication.AbstractAuthenticationToken;\nimport org.springframework.security.core.GrantedAuthority;\nimport org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority;\nimport org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;\nimport org.springframework.security.oauth2.server.resource.authentication.JwtAuthenticationToken;\nimport org.springframework.security.oauth2.server.resource.authentication.JwtGrantedAuthoritiesConverter;\n\n/**\n * Translates a Keycloak access token into a Spring {@link AbstractAuthenticationToken}\n * with the right authorities for our RBAC matrix.\n *\n * <p>Keycloak places realm roles inside {@code realm_access.roles}. Spring\n * Security's default converter only picks up {@code scope}/{@code scp}, so\n * we extend it manually.\n *\n * <p>Authorities produced look like:\n * <ul>\n *   <li>{@code ROLE_HR_ADMIN}      (from realm role {@code HR_ADMIN})</li>\n *   <li>{@code SCOPE_profile}      (from OAuth2 scope, kept for diagnostics)</li>\n * </ul>\n *\n * <p>The principal name is the {@code preferred_username} claim if present,\n * else {@code email}, else {@code sub}.\n */\npublic final class JwtRoleConverter implements Converter<Jwt, AbstractAuthenticationToken> {\n\n    private static final String CLAIM_REALM_ACCESS = \"realm_access\";\n    private static final String CLAIM_ROLES = \"roles\";\n\n    private final JwtGrantedAuthoritiesConverter scopeConverter = new JwtGrantedAuthoritiesConverter();\n\n    @Override\n    public AbstractAuthenticationToken convert(Jwt jwt) {\n        Collection<GrantedAuthority> authorities = new ArrayList<>(scopeConverter.convert(jwt));\n        authorities.addAll(extractRealmRoles(jwt));\n        String principalName = resolvePrincipalName(jwt);\n        return new JwtAuthenticationToken(jwt, authorities, principalName);\n    }\n\n    private Set<GrantedAuthority> extractRealmRoles(Jwt jwt) {\n        Map<String, Object> realmAccess = jwt.getClaimAsMap(CLAIM_REALM_ACCESS);\n        if (realmAccess == null) {\n            return Set.of();\n        }\n        Object rolesObj = realmAccess.get(CLAIM_ROLES);\n        if (!(rolesObj instanceof List<?> rawRoles)) {\n            return Set.of();\n        }\n        Set<GrantedAuthority> result = new HashSet<>();\n        for (Object role : rawRoles) {\n            if (role instanceof String s && !s.isBlank()) {\n                result.add(new SimpleGrantedAuthority(Roles.AUTHORITY_PREFIX + s));\n            }\n        }\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    private static String resolvePrincipalName(Jwt jwt) {\n        String preferred = jwt.getClaimAsString(\"preferred_username\");\n        if (preferred != null && !preferred.isBlank()) {\n            return preferred;\n        }\n        String email = jwt.getClaimAsString(\"email\");\n        if (email != null && !email.isBlank()) {\n            return email;\n        }\n        return jwt.getSubject();\n    }\n"

            "code": "package com.acme.hrms.me;\n\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.TreeSet;\n\nimport org.slf4j.MDC;\nimport org.springframework.security.core.annotation.AuthenticationPrincipal;\nimport org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;\n\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.audit.AuditAction;\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.audit.AuditEvent;\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.audit.AuditService;\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.security.CurrentUser;\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.web.RequestIdFilter;\n\nimport io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;\nimport io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;\n\n/**\n * Identity probe.\n *\n * <p>Used by the SPA right after login to render the current user's name +\n * roles in the navbar without needing to decode the token client-side.\n * Also doubles as a smoke-test endpoint: if {@code /api/me} returns 200\n * with the right roles, auth wiring works.\n *\n * <p>Each successful call writes one {@link AuditAction#LOGIN} row, which\n * is enough to demonstrate the audit pipeline end-to-end without lighting\n * up audit on every request (we'll do that explicitly per feature later).\n */\n@RestController\n@RequestMapping(\"/api/me\")\n@Tag(name = \"Me\", description = \"Current user identity\")\npublic class MeController {\n\n    private final AuditService auditService;\n\n    public MeController(AuditService auditService) {\n        this.auditService = auditService;\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping\n    @Operation(summary = \"Return the identity and realm roles of the caller\")\n    public MeResponse me(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {\n        CurrentUser user = CurrentUser.from(jwt);\n        List<String> sortedRoles = List.copyOf(new TreeSet<>(user.roles()));\n\n        auditService.record(\n                AuditEvent.of(AuditAction.LOGIN, \"session\")\n                        .withDetail(\"GET /api/me\"));\n\n        return new MeResponse(\n                user.subjectUuid(),\n                user.username(),\n                user.email(),\n                sortedRoles,\n                MDC.get(RequestIdFilter.MDC_KEY));\n    }\n}"

            "code": "package com.acme.hrms.common.security;\n\nimport java.util.Optional;\nimport java.util.Set;\nimport java.util.UUID;\n\nimport org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;\nimport org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;\nimport org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;\nimport org.springframework.security.oauth2.server.resource.authentication.JwtAuthenticationToken;\n\n/**\n * Snapshot of the caller built from the validated JWT.\n *\n * <p>Pass this through to services that need to make authorisation decisions\n * or write {@code created_by} / {@code updated_by} columns. Never read the\n * {@link SecurityContextHolder} from inside services — take a {@code CurrentUser}\n * argument instead, both for testability and to make the contract explicit.\n *\n * <p>The {@code subjectUuid} field is the Keycloak user id, which we mirror\n * into {@code employee.keycloak_user_id} once the employee module lands.\n */\npublic record CurrentUser(\n        UUID subjectUuid,\n        String username,\n        String email,\n        Set<String> roles\n) {\n\n    public boolean hasRole(String role) {\n        return roles.contains(role);\n    }\n\n    public boolean hasAnyRole(String... candidates) {\n        for (String r : candidates) {\n            if (roles.contains(r)) {\n                return true;\n            }\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Resolve the current user from the security context, if any. Returns\n     * empty for anonymous / unauthenticated requests.\n     */\n    public static Optional<CurrentUser> fromSecurityContext() {\n        Authentication auth = SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();\n        if (!(auth instanceof JwtAuthenticationToken token)) {\n            return Optional.empty();\n        }\n        return Optional.of(from(token.getToken()));\n    }\n\n    public static CurrentUser from(Jwt jwt) {\n        UUID subject = parseSubjectAsUuid(jwt.getSubject());\n        String username = jwt.getClaimAsString(\"preferred_username\");\n        String email = jwt.getClaimAsString(\"email\");\n        Set<String> roles = JwtRoleConverter.rolesOf(jwt);\n        return new CurrentUser(subject, username, email, roles);\n    }\n\n    private static UUID parseSubjectAsUuid(String subject) {\n        if (subject == null || subject.isBlank()) {\n            return null;\n        }\n        try {\n            return UUID.fromString(subject);\n        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {\n            // Keycloak issues UUID subjects, but a non-UUID 'sub' (e.g. for a\n            // service account or external IdP) shouldn't blow up auth.\n            return null;\n        }\n    }\n}"
          }

            "code": "package com.acme.hrms.common.persistence;\n\nimport java.util.Optional;\nimport java.util.UUID;\n\nimport org.springframework.data.domain.AuditorAware;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Component;\n\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.security.CurrentUser;\n\n/**\n * Provides the actor UUID for {@code @CreatedBy} / {@code @LastModifiedBy}.\n *\n * <p>For requests with a JWT, returns the Keycloak subject UUID from the\n * security context. For unauthenticated paths or background jobs (no\n * security context yet, but coming in later phases) returns\n * {@link Optional#empty()} — the column is nullable on purpose so we can\n * recognise rows written outside an HTTP context.\n */\n@Component(\"auditorAware\")\npublic class SecurityContextAuditorAware implements AuditorAware<UUID> {\n\n    @Override\n    public Optional<UUID> getCurrentAuditor() {\n        return CurrentUser.fromSecurityContext()\n                .map(CurrentUser::subjectUuid)\n                .filter(uuid -> uuid != null);\n    }\n}"

            "code": "        return result;\n    }\n\n    private static String resolvePrincipalName(Jwt jwt) {\n        String preferred = jwt.getClaimAsString(\"preferred_username\");\n        if (preferred != null && !preferred.isBlank()) {\n            return preferred;\n        }\n        String email = jwt.getClaimAsString(\"email\");\n        if (email != null && !email.isBlank()) {\n            return email;\n        }\n        return jwt.getSubject();\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Convenience: return only the role names (without the {@code ROLE_}\n     * prefix) for a given JWT. Useful from {@link CurrentUser}.\n     */\n    public static Set<String> rolesOf(Jwt jwt) {\n        Map<String, Object> realmAccess = jwt.getClaimAsMap(CLAIM_REALM_ACCESS);\n        if (realmAccess == null) {\n            return Set.of();\n        }\n        Object rolesObj = realmAccess.get(CLAIM_ROLES);\n        if (!(rolesObj instanceof List<?> rawRoles)) {\n            return Set.of();\n        }\n        return rawRoles.stream()\n                .filter(String.class::isInstance)\n                .map(String.class::cast)\n                .filter(s -> !s.isBlank())\n                .collect(Collectors.toUnmodifiableSet());\n    }\n}"
          }

            "code": "package com.acme.hrms.me;\n\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.TreeSet;\n\nimport org.slf4j.MDC;\nimport org.springframework.security.core.annotation.AuthenticationPrincipal;\nimport org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;\n\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.audit.AuditAction;\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.audit.AuditEvent;\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.audit.AuditService;\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.security.CurrentUser;\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.web.RequestIdFilter;\n\nimport io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;\nimport io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;\n\n/**\n * Identity probe.\n *\n * <p>Used by the SPA right after login to render the current user's name +\n * roles in the navbar without needing to decode the token client-side.\n * Also doubles as a smoke-test endpoint: if {@code /api/me} returns 200\n * with the right roles, auth wiring works.\n *\n * <p>Each successful call writes one {@link AuditAction#LOGIN} row, which\n * is enough to demonstrate the audit pipeline end-to-end without lighting\n * up audit on every request (we'll do that explicitly per feature later).\n */\n@RestController\n@RequestMapping(\"/api/me\")\n@Tag(name = \"Me\", description = \"Current user identity\")\npublic class MeController {\n\n    private final AuditService auditService;\n\n    public MeController(AuditService auditService) {\n        this.auditService = auditService;\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping\n    @Operation(summary = \"Return the identity and realm roles of the caller\")\n    public MeResponse me(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {\n        CurrentUser user = CurrentUser.from(jwt);\n        List<String> sortedRoles = List.copyOf(new TreeSet<>(user.roles()));\n\n        auditService.record(\n                AuditEvent.of(AuditAction.LOGIN, \"session\")\n                        .withDetail(\"GET /api/me\"));\n\n        return new MeResponse(\n                user.subjectUuid(),\n                user.username(),\n                user.email(),\n                sortedRoles,\n                MDC.get(RequestIdFilter.MDC_KEY));\n    }\n}"

            "docstring": "* Helpers for issuing test bearer tokens with specific subject + roles.\n *\n * <p>Centralised so individual tests don't repeat the JWT-builder dance.\n * Always passes the same claims a real Keycloak token would carry:\n * {@code sub}, {@code preferred_username}, {@code email}, and the\n * {@code realm_access.roles} array.",
            "imports": [

            ],
            "chunk_index": 0,
            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "package com.acme.hrms.support;\n\nimport java.util.Arrays;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\nimport java.util.UUID;\n\nimport org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority;\nimport org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;\nimport org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.RequestPostProcessor;\n\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.security.Roles;\n\nimport static org.springframework.security.test.web.servlet.request.SecurityMockMvcRequestPostProcessors.jwt;\n\n/**\n * Helpers for issuing test bearer tokens with specific subject + roles.\n *\n * <p>Centralised so individual tests don't repeat the JWT-builder dance.\n * Always passes the same claims a real Keycloak token would carry:\n * {@code sub}, {@code preferred_username}, {@code email}, and the\n * {@code realm_access.roles} array.\n */\npublic final class JwtTestSupport {\n\n    private JwtTestSupport() {\n    }\n\n    public static RequestPostProcessor asUser(UUID subject, String username, String... roles) {\n        List<String> roleList = Arrays.asList(roles);\n        SimpleGrantedAuthority[] authorities = roleList.stream()\n                .map(r -> new SimpleGrantedAuthority(Roles.AUTHORITY_PREFIX + r))\n                .toArray(SimpleGrantedAuthority[]::new);\n        return jwt()\n                .jwt(builder -> applyClaims(builder, subject, username, roleList))\n                .authorities(authorities);\n    }\n\n    private static void applyClaims(Jwt.Builder builder, UUID subject, String username, List<String> roles) {\n        builder.subject(subject.toString())\n                .claim(\"preferred_username\", username)\n                .claim(\"email\", username)\n                .claim(\"realm_access\", Map.of(\"roles\", roles));\n    }\n}"
          }
        }

            "docstring": "* Translates a Keycloak access token into a Spring {@link AbstractAuthenticationToken}\n * with the right authorities for our RBAC matrix.\n *\n * <p>Keycloak places realm roles inside {@code realm_access.roles}. Spring\n * Security's default converter only picks up {@code scope}/{@code scp}, so\n * we extend it manually.\n *\n * <p>Authorities produced look like:\n * <ul>\n *   <li>{@code ROLE_HR_ADMIN}      (from realm role {@code HR_ADMIN})</li>\n *   <li>{@code SCOPE_profile}      (from OAuth2 scope, kept for diagnostics)</li>\n * </ul>\n *\n * <p>The principal name is the {@code preferred_username} claim if present,\n * else {@code email}, else {@code sub}.",

CLAIM_REALM_ACCESS = \"realm_access\";\n    private static final String CLAIM_ROLES = \"roles\";\n\n    private final JwtGrantedAuthoritiesConverter scopeConverter = new ArrayList<>(scopeConverter.convert(jwt));\n        authorities.addAll(extractRealmRoles(jwt));\n        String principalName = resolvePrincipalName(jwt);\n        return new             "code": "package com.acme.hrms.common.security;\n\nimport java.util.Optional;\nimport java.util.Set;\nimport java.util.UUID;\n\nimport org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;\nimport org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;\nimport org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;\nimport org.springframework.security.oauth2.server.resource.authentication.JwtAuthenticationToken;\n\n/**\n * Snapshot of the caller built from the validated JWT.\n *\n * <p>Pass this through to services that need to make authorisation decisions\n * or write {@code created_by} / {@code updated_by} columns. Never read the\n * {@link SecurityContextHolder} from inside services — take a {@code CurrentUser}\n * argument instead, both for testability and to make the contract explicit.\n *\n * <p>The {@code subjectUuid} field is the Keycloak user id, which we mirror\n * into {@code employee.keycloak_user_id} once the employee module lands.\n */\npublic record CurrentUser(\n        UUID subjectUuid,\n        String username,\n        String email,\n        Set<String> roles\n) {\n\n    public boolean hasRole(String role) {\n        return roles.contains(role);\n    }\n\n    public boolean hasAnyRole(String... candidates) {\n        for (String r : candidates) {\n            if (roles.contains(r)) {\n                return true;\n            }\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Resolve the current user from the security context, if any. Returns\n     * empty for anonymous / unauthenticated requests.\n     */\n    public static Optional<CurrentUser> fromSecurityContext() {\n        Authentication auth = SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();\n        if (!(auth instanceof JwtAuthenticationToken token)) {\n            return Optional.empty();\n        }\n        return Optional.of(from(token.getToken()));\n    }\n\n    public static CurrentUser from(Jwt jwt) {\n        UUID subject = parseSubjectAsUuid(jwt.getSubject());\n        String username = jwt.getClaimAsString(\"preferred_username\");\n        String email = jwt.getClaimAsString(\"email\");\n        Set<String> roles = JwtRoleConverter.rolesOf(jwt);\n        return new CurrentUser(subject, username, email, roles);\n    }\n\n    private static UUID parseSubjectAsUuid(String subject) {\n        if (subject == null || subject.isBlank()) {\n            return null;\n        }\n        try {\n            return UUID.fromString(subject);\n        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {\n            // Keycloak issues UUID subjects, but a non-UUID 'sub' (e.g. for a\n            // service account or external IdP) shouldn't blow up auth.\n            return null;\n        }\n    }\n}"
          }

            ],
            "chunk_index": 0,
            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "package com.acme.hrms.support;\n\nimport java.util.Arrays;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\nimport java.util.UUID;\n\nimport org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority;\nimport org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;\nimport org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.RequestPostProcessor;\n\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.security.Roles;\n\nimport static org.springframework.security.test.web.servlet.request.SecurityMockMvcRequestPostProcessors.jwt;\n\n/**\n * Helpers for issuing test bearer tokens with specific subject + roles.\n *\n * <p>Centralised so individual tests don't repeat the JWT-builder dance.\n * Always passes the same claims a real Keycloak token would carry:\n * {@code sub}, {@code preferred_username}, {@code email}, and the\n * {@code realm_access.roles} array.\n */\npublic final class JwtTestSupport {\n\n    private JwtTestSupport() {\n    }\n\n    public static RequestPostProcessor asUser(UUID subject, String username, String... roles) {\n        List<String> roleList = Arrays.asList(roles);\n        SimpleGrantedAuthority[] authorities = roleList.stream()\n                .map(r -> new SimpleGrantedAuthority(Roles.AUTHORITY_PREFIX + r))\n                .toArray(SimpleGrantedAuthority[]::new);\n        return jwt()\n                .jwt(builder -> applyClaims(builder, subject, username, roleList))\n                .authorities(authorities);\n    }\n\n    private static void applyClaims(Jwt.Builder builder, UUID subject, String username, List<String> roles) {\n        builder.subject(subject.toString())\n                .claim(\"preferred_username\", username)\n                .claim(\"email\", username)\n                .claim(\"realm_access\", Map.of(\"roles\", roles));\n    }\n}"
          }
        }

            "code": "package com.acme.hrms.common.security;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.Collection;\nimport java.util.HashSet;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\nimport java.util.Set;\nimport java.util.stream.Collectors;\n\nimport org.springframework.core.convert.converter.Converter;\nimport org.springframework.security.authentication.AbstractAuthenticationToken;\nimport org.springframework.security.core.GrantedAuthority;\nimport org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority;\nimport org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;\nimport org.springframework.security.oauth2.server.resource.authentication.JwtAuthenticationToken;\nimport org.springframework.security.oauth2.server.resource.authentication.JwtGrantedAuthoritiesConverter;\n\n/**\n * Translates a Keycloak access token into a Spring {@link AbstractAuthenticationToken}\n * with the right authorities for our RBAC matrix.\n *\n * <p>Keycloak places realm roles inside {@code realm_access.roles}. Spring\n * Security's default converter only picks up {@code scope}/{@code scp}, so\n * we extend it manually.\n *\n * <p>Authorities produced look like:\n * <ul>\n *   <li>{@code ROLE_HR_ADMIN}      (from realm role {@code HR_ADMIN})</li>\n *   <li>{@code SCOPE_profile}      (from OAuth2 scope, kept for diagnostics)</li>\n * </ul>\n *\n * <p>The principal name is the {@code preferred_username} claim if present,\n * else {@code email}, else {@code sub}.\n */\npublic final class JwtRoleConverter implements Converter<Jwt, AbstractAuthenticationToken> {\n\n    private static final String CLAIM_REALM_ACCESS = \"realm_access\";\n    private static final String CLAIM_ROLES = \"roles\";\n\n    private final JwtGrantedAuthoritiesConverter scopeConverter = new JwtGrantedAuthoritiesConverter();\n\n    @Override\n    public AbstractAuthenticationToken convert(Jwt jwt) {\n        Collection<GrantedAuthority> authorities = new ArrayList<>(scopeConverter.convert(jwt));\n        authorities.addAll(extractRealmRoles(jwt));\n        String principalName = resolvePrincipalName(jwt);\n        return new JwtAuthenticationToken(jwt, authorities, principalName);\n    }\n\n    private Set<GrantedAuthority> extractRealmRoles(Jwt jwt) {\n        Map<String, Object> realmAccess = jwt.getClaimAsMap(CLAIM_REALM_ACCESS);\n        if (realmAccess == null) {\n            return Set.of();\n        }\n        Object rolesObj = realmAccess.get(CLAIM_ROLES);\n        if (!(rolesObj instanceof List<?> rawRoles)) {\n            return Set.of();\n        }\n        Set<GrantedAuthority> result = new HashSet<>();\n        for (Object role : rawRoles) {\n            if (role instanceof String s && !s.isBlank()) {\n                result.add(new SimpleGrantedAuthority(Roles.AUTHORITY_PREFIX + s));\n            }\n        }\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    private static String resolvePrincipalName(Jwt jwt) {\n        String preferred = jwt.getClaimAsString(\"preferred_username\");\n        if (preferred != null && !preferred.isBlank()) {\n            return preferred;\n        }\n        String email = jwt.getClaimAsString(\"email\");\n        if (email != null && !email.isBlank()) {\n            return email;\n        }\n        return jwt.getSubject();\n    }\n"
