        "summary": "### Frontend Architecture Overview\n\nThe frontend of the Human Resource Management System (HRMS) is structured around a React application that provides an intuitive interface for users to interact with the system. The application includes several key components and utilities that are essential for its functionality.\n\n#### Components & Configurations\n1. **components.json**\n   - **Role**: This JSON file manages frontend components and configurations.\n   - **Dependencies**:\n     - Tailwind CSS: Integrated for consistent styling across the application.\n     - Lucide Icons: Used to provide a set of icons to enhance UI elements.\n   - **Main Exports**:\n     - Aliases for commonly used directories like `components`, `utils`, `ui`.\n\n2. **Silent Single Sign-On (SSO)**\n   - **silent-check-sso.html**\n     - **Role**: A simple HTML file that facilitates silent SSO by sending the current URL to the parent window using `postMessage`.\n     - **Dependencies**:\n       - Browser APIs for interaction with parent frames.\n     - **Main Exports**: None explicitly exported; performs an action and exits.\n\n### Backend Architecture Overview\n\nThe backend of the HRMS system is built on Java using Spring Boot, providing a robust architecture for handling business logic, security, and data management.\n\n#### Security Management\n1. **CurrentUser.java**\n   - **Role**: Represents the authenticated user in the system.\n   - **Dependencies**:\n     - Spring Security: Utilized for authentication processes.\n   - **Main Exports**:\n     - Methods to check user roles, extract user details, and retrieve the current user instance.\n\n#### Error Handling\n2. **FieldError.java**\n   - **Role**: Represents individual validation errors for fields in API responses.\n   - **Dependencies**: None; self-contained within the same package.\n   - **Main Exports**:\n     - A record with three fields: `field`, `code`, and `message`.\n\n### Additional Scripts\n\n1. **file_discovery.py**\n   - **Role**: A script to discover files within a directory tree while excluding specific directories.\n   - **Dependencies**:\n     - Python's `pathlib` module.\n   - **Main Exports**:\n     - The `discover_files` function.\n\n2. **export_repository_dump.py**\n   - **Role**: Exports the contents of selected folders into a single Markdown file, ignoring certain files and directories.\n   - **Dependencies**:\n     - Python’s `pathlib` for path manipulations.\n   - **Main Exports**:\n     - The repository's contents exported into a Markdown file.\n\n### Integration & Dependencies\n\n- The frontend communicates with the backend through HTTP/HTTPS requests to fetch data, handle user interactions, and manage authentication. This interaction is managed by Spring Security on the backend, ensuring that all requests are authenticated and authorized.\n  \n- The `silent-check-sso.html` script, part of the frontend, facilitates silent SSO by interacting with the parent window via `postMessage`. This allows for a seamless login experience without user intervention.\n\n- The backend scripts (`file_discovery.py`, `export_repository_dump.py`) provide utilities that can be invoked from within the application or as standalone scripts. These scripts help in managing file operations and repository exports, respectively.\n\n### Key Entry Points\n\n- **Frontend Entry Point**: \n  - The main entry point for the frontend React application is typically a file like `index.js` or `main.js`. This file initializes the React app and renders it into the DOM.\n\n- **Backend Entry Point**:\n  - The backend is bootstrapped via a Spring Boot application class, usually annotated with `@SpringBootApplication`.\n\n### Summary\n\nThe frontend of the HRMS system is built on React and provides a user-friendly interface for interacting with various features of the system. It includes components managed by `components.json`, handles SSO silently using `silent-check-sso.html`, and communicates securely with the backend via HTTP/HTTPS requests.\n\nThe backend, written in Java with Spring Boot, manages authentication, authorization, and business logic.             "code": "class EmbeddingBuilder:\n\n    model_name = \"local-hash-v1\"\n    dimensions = 64\n\n    def build(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[float]:\n\n        vector = [0.0] * self.dimensions\n\n        for token in self._tokens(text):\n            digest = hashlib.sha256(\n                token.encode(\"utf-8\")\n            ).digest()\n            index = int.from_bytes(\n                digest[:2],\n                \"big\"\n            ) % self.dimensions\n            sign = 1.0 if digest[2] % 2 == 0 else -1.0\n            vector[index] += sign\n\n        norm = math.sqrt(\n            sum(value * value for value in vector)\n        )\n\n        if not norm:\n            return vector\n\n        return [\n            round(value / norm, 6)\n            for value in vector\n        ]\n\n    def content_hash(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> str:\n\n        return hashlib.sha256(\n            text.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        ).hexdigest()\n\n    def _tokens(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[str]:\n\n        return re.findall(\n            r\"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\",\n            text.lower()\n        )",

            "code": "class EmbeddingBuilder:\n\n    model_name = \"local-hash-v1\"\n    dimensions = 64\n\n    def build(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[float]:\n\n        vector = [0.0] * self.dimensions\n\n        for token in self._tokens(text):\n            digest = hashlib.sha256(\n                token.encode(\"utf-8\")\n            ).digest()\n            index = int.from_bytes(\n                digest[:2],\n                \"big\"\n            ) % self.dimensions\n            sign = 1.0 if digest[2] % 2 == 0 else -1.0\n            vector[index] += sign\n\n        norm = math.sqrt(\n            sum(value * value for value in vector)\n        )\n\n        if not norm:\n            return vector\n\n        return [\n            round(value / norm, 6)\n            for value in vector\n        ]\n\n    def content_hash(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> str:\n\n        return hashlib.sha256(\n            text.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        ).hexdigest()\n\n    def _tokens(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[str]:\n\n        return re.findall(\n            r\"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\",\n            text.lower()\n        )",

            "code": "class EmbeddingBuilder:\n\n    model_name = \"local-hash-v1\"\n    dimensions = 64\n\n    def build(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[float]:\n\n        vector = [0.0] * self.dimensions\n\n        for token in self._tokens(text):\n            digest = hashlib.sha256(\n                token.encode(\"utf-8\")\n            ).digest()\n            index = int.from_bytes(\n                digest[:2],\n                \"big\"\n            ) % self.dimensions\n            sign = 1.0 if digest[2] % 2 == 0 else -1.0\n            vector[index] += sign\n\n        norm = math.sqrt(\n            sum(value * value for value in vector)\n        )\n\n        if not norm:\n            return vector\n\n        return [\n            round(value / norm, 6)\n            for value in vector\n        ]\n\n    def content_hash(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> str:\n\n        return hashlib.sha256(\n            text.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        ).hexdigest()\n\n    def _tokens(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[str]:\n\n        return re.findall(\n            r\"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\",\n            text.lower()\n        )",

            "chunk_index": 0,
            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class EmbeddingBuilder:\n\n    model_name = \"local-hash-v1\"\n    dimensions = 64\n\n    def build(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[float]:\n\n        vector = [0.0] * self.dimensions\n\n        for token in self._tokens(text):\n            digest = hashlib.sha256(\n                token.encode(\"utf-8\")\n            ).digest()\n            index = int.from_bytes(\n                digest[:2],\n                \"big\"\n            ) % self.dimensions\n            sign = 1.0 if digest[2] % 2 == 0 else -1.0\n            vector[index] += sign\n\n        norm = math.sqrt(\n            sum(value * value for value in vector)\n        )\n\n        if not norm:\n            return vector\n\n        return [\n            round(value / norm, 6)\n            for value in vector\n        ]\n\n    def content_hash(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> str:\n\n        return hashlib.sha256(\n            text.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        ).hexdigest()\n\n    def _tokens(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[str]:\n\n        return re.findall(\n            r\"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\",\n            text.lower()\n        )",

            "code": "class EmbeddingBuilder:\n\n    model_name = \"local-hash-v1\"\n    dimensions = 64\n\n    def build(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[float]:\n\n        vector = [0.0] * self.dimensions\n\n        for token in self._tokens(text):\n            digest = hashlib.sha256(\n                token.encode(\"utf-8\")\n            ).digest()\n            index = int.from_bytes(\n                digest[:2],\n                \"big\"\n            ) % self.dimensions\n            sign = 1.0 if digest[2] % 2 == 0 else -1.0\n            vector[index] += sign\n\n        norm = math.sqrt(\n            sum(value * value for value in vector)\n        )\n\n        if not norm:\n            return vector\n\n        return [\n            round(value / norm, 6)\n            for value in vector\n        ]\n\n    def content_hash(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> str:\n\n        return hashlib.sha256(\n            text.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        ).hexdigest()\n\n    def _tokens(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[str]:\n\n        return re.findall(\n            r\"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\",\n            text.lower()\n        )",

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class EmbeddingBuilder:\n\n    model_name = \"local-hash-v1\"\n    dimensions = 64\n\n    def build(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[float]:\n\n        vector = [0.0] * self.dimensions\n\n        for token in self._tokens(text):\n            digest = hashlib.sha256(\n                token.encode(\"utf-8\")\n            ).digest()\n            index = int.from_bytes(\n                digest[:2],\n                \"big\"\n            ) % self.dimensions\n            sign = 1.0 if digest[2] % 2 == 0 else -1.0\n            vector[index] += sign\n\n        norm = math.sqrt(\n            sum(value * value for value in vector)\n        )\n\n        if not norm:\n            return vector\n\n        return [\n            round(value / norm, 6)\n            for value in vector\n        ]\n\n    def content_hash(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> str:\n\n        return hashlib.sha256(\n            text.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        ).hexdigest()\n\n    def _tokens(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[str]:\n\n        return re.findall(\n            r\"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\",\n            text.lower()\n        )",

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class EmbeddingBuilder:\n\n    model_name = \"local-hash-v1\"\n    dimensions = 64\n\n    def build(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[float]:\n\n        vector = [0.0] * self.dimensions\n\n        for token in self._tokens(text):\n            digest = hashlib.sha256(\n                token.encode(\"utf-8\")\n            ).digest()\n            index = int.from_bytes(\n                digest[:2],\n                \"big\"\n            ) % self.dimensions\n            sign = 1.0 if digest[2] % 2 == 0 else -1.0\n            vector[index] += sign\n\n        norm = math.sqrt(\n            sum(value * value for value in vector)\n        )\n\n        if not norm:\n            return vector\n\n        return [\n            round(value / norm, 6)\n            for value in vector\n        ]\n\n    def content_hash(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> str:\n\n        return hashlib.sha256(\n            text.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        ).hexdigest()\n\n    def _tokens(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[str]:\n\n        return re.findall(\n            r\"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\",\n            text.lower()\n        )",

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class EmbeddingBuilder:\n\n    model_name = \"local-hash-v1\"\n    dimensions = 64\n\n    def build(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[float]:\n\n        vector = [0.0] * self.dimensions\n\n        for token in self._tokens(text):\n            digest = hashlib.sha256(\n                token.encode(\"utf-8\")\n            ).digest()\n            index = int.from_bytes(\n                digest[:2],\n                \"big\"\n            ) % self.dimensions\n            sign = 1.0 if digest[2] % 2 == 0 else -1.0\n            vector[index] += sign\n\n        norm = math.sqrt(\n            sum(value * value for value in vector)\n        )\n\n        if not norm:\n            return vector\n\n        return [\n            round(value / norm, 6)\n            for value in vector\n        ]\n\n    def content_hash(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> str:\n\n        return hashlib.sha256(\n            text.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        ).hexdigest()\n\n    def _tokens(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[str]:\n\n        return re.findall(\n            r\"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\",\n            text.lower()\n        )",

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class EmbeddingBuilder:\n\n    model_name = \"local-hash-v1\"\n    dimensions = 64\n\n    def build(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[float]:\n\n        vector = [0.0] * self.dimensions\n\n        for token in self._tokens(text):\n            digest = hashlib.sha256(\n                token.encode(\"utf-8\")\n            ).digest()\n            index = int.from_bytes(\n                digest[:2],\n                \"big\"\n            ) % self.dimensions\n            sign = 1.0 if digest[2] % 2 == 0 else -1.0\n            vector[index] += sign\n\n        norm = math.sqrt(\n            sum(value * value for value in vector)\n        )\n\n        if not norm:\n            return vector\n\n        return [\n            round(value / norm, 6)\n            for value in vector\n        ]\n\n    def content_hash(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> str:\n\n        return hashlib.sha256(\n            text.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        ).hexdigest()\n\n    def _tokens(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[str]:\n\n        return re.findall(\n            r\"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\",\n            text.lower()\n        )",

            "chunk_index": 0,
            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class EmbeddingBuilder:\n\n    model_name = \"local-hash-v1\"\n    dimensions = 64\n\n    def build(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[float]:\n\n        vector = [0.0] * self.dimensions\n\n        for token in self._tokens(text):\n            digest = hashlib.sha256(\n                token.encode(\"utf-8\")\n            ).digest()\n            index = int.from_bytes(\n                digest[:2],\n                \"big\"\n            ) % self.dimensions\n            sign = 1.0 if digest[2] % 2 == 0 else -1.0\n            vector[index] += sign\n\n        norm = math.sqrt(\n            sum(value * value for value in vector)\n        )\n\n        if not norm:\n            return vector\n\n        return [\n            round(value / norm, 6)\n            for value in vector\n        ]\n\n    def content_hash(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> str:\n\n        return hashlib.sha256(\n            text.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        ).hexdigest()\n\n    def _tokens(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[str]:\n\n        return re.findall(\n            r\"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\",\n            text.lower()\n        )",

            "code": "class EmbeddingBuilder:\n\n    model_name = \"local-hash-v1\"\n    dimensions = 64\n\n    def build(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[float]:\n\n        vector = [0.0] * self.dimensions\n\n        for token in self._tokens(text):\n            digest = hashlib.sha256(\n                token.encode(\"utf-8\")\n            ).digest()\n            index = int.from_bytes(\n                digest[:2],\n                \"big\"\n            ) % self.dimensions\n            sign = 1.0 if digest[2] % 2 == 0 else -1.0\n            vector[index] += sign\n\n        norm = math.sqrt(\n            sum(value * value for value in vector)\n        )\n\n        if not norm:\n            return vector\n\n        return [\n            round(value / norm, 6)\n            for value in vector\n        ]\n\n    def content_hash(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> str:\n\n        return hashlib.sha256(\n            text.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        ).hexdigest()\n\n    def _tokens(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[str]:\n\n        return re.findall(\n            r\"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\",\n            text.lower()\n        )",

            "chunk_index": 0,
            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class EmbeddingBuilder:\n\n    model_name = \"local-hash-v1\"\n    dimensions = 64\n\n    def build(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[float]:\n\n        vector = [0.0] * self.dimensions\n\n        for token in self._tokens(text):\n            digest = hashlib.sha256(\n                token.encode(\"utf-8\")\n            ).digest()\n            index = int.from_bytes(\n                digest[:2],\n                \"big\"\n            ) % self.dimensions\n            sign = 1.0 if digest[2] % 2 == 0 else -1.0\n            vector[index] += sign\n\n        norm = math.sqrt(\n            sum(value * value for value in vector)\n        )\n\n        if not norm:\n            return vector\n\n        return [\n            round(value / norm, 6)\n            for value in vector\n        ]\n\n    def content_hash(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> str:\n\n        return hashlib.sha256(\n            text.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        ).hexdigest()\n\n    def _tokens(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[str]:\n\n        return re.findall(\n            r\"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\",\n            text.lower()\n        )",

            "chunk_index": 0,
            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class EmbeddingBuilder:\n\n    model_name = \"local-hash-v1\"\n    dimensions = 64\n\n    def build(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[float]:\n\n        vector = [0.0] * self.dimensions\n\n        for token in self._tokens(text):\n            digest = hashlib.sha256(\n                token.encode(\"utf-8\")\n            ).digest()\n            index = int.from_bytes(\n                digest[:2],\n                \"big\"\n            ) % self.dimensions\n            sign = 1.0 if digest[2] % 2 == 0 else -1.0\n            vector[index] += sign\n\n        norm = math.sqrt(\n            sum(value * value for value in vector)\n        )\n\n        if not norm:\n            return vector\n\n        return [\n            round(value / norm, 6)\n            for value in vector\n        ]\n\n    def content_hash(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> str:\n\n        return hashlib.sha256(\n            text.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        ).hexdigest()\n\n    def _tokens(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[str]:\n\n        return re.findall(\n            r\"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\",\n            text.lower()\n        )",

            "code": "class EmbeddingBuilder:\n\n    model_name = \"local-hash-v1\"\n    dimensions = 64\n\n    def build(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[float]:\n\n        vector = [0.0] * self.dimensions\n\n        for token in self._tokens(text):\n            digest = hashlib.sha256(\n                token.encode(\"utf-8\")\n            ).digest()\n            index = int.from_bytes(\n                digest[:2],\n                \"big\"\n            ) % self.dimensions\n            sign = 1.0 if digest[2] % 2 == 0 else -1.0\n            vector[index] += sign\n\n        norm = math.sqrt(\n            sum(value * value for value in vector)\n        )\n\n        if not norm:\n            return vector\n\n        return [\n            round(value / norm, 6)\n            for value in vector\n        ]\n\n    def content_hash(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> str:\n\n        return hashlib.sha256(\n            text.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        ).hexdigest()\n\n    def _tokens(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[str]:\n\n        return re.findall(\n            r\"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\",\n            text.lower()\n        )",

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class EmbeddingBuilder:\n\n    model_name = \"local-hash-v1\"\n    dimensions = 64\n\n    def build(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[float]:\n\n        vector = [0.0] * self.dimensions\n\n        for token in self._tokens(text):\n            digest = hashlib.sha256(\n                token.encode(\"utf-8\")\n            ).digest()\n            index = int.from_bytes(\n                digest[:2],\n                \"big\"\n            ) % self.dimensions\n            sign = 1.0 if digest[2] % 2 == 0 else -1.0\n            vector[index] += sign\n\n        norm = math.sqrt(\n            sum(value * value for value in vector)\n        )\n\n        if not norm:\n            return vector\n\n        return [\n            round(value / norm, 6)\n            for value in vector\n        ]\n\n    def content_hash(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> str:\n\n        return hashlib.sha256(\n            text.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        ).hexdigest()\n\n    def _tokens(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[str]:\n\n        return re.findall(\n            r\"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\",\n            text.lower()\n        )",

            "code": "class EmbeddingBuilder:\n\n    model_name = \"local-hash-v1\"\n    dimensions = 64\n\n    def build(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[float]:\n\n        vector = [0.0] * self.dimensions\n\n        for token in self._tokens(text):\n            digest = hashlib.sha256(\n                token.encode(\"utf-8\")\n            ).digest()\n            index = int.from_bytes(\n                digest[:2],\n                \"big\"\n            ) % self.dimensions\n            sign = 1.0 if digest[2] % 2 == 0 else -1.0\n            vector[index] += sign\n\n        norm = math.sqrt(\n            sum(value * value for value in vector)\n        )\n\n        if not norm:\n            return vector\n\n        return [\n            round(value / norm, 6)\n            for value in vector\n        ]\n\n    def content_hash(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> str:\n\n        return hashlib.sha256(\n            text.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        ).hexdigest()\n\n    def _tokens(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[str]:\n\n        return re.findall(\n            r\"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\",\n            text.lower()\n        )",

            "chunk_index": 0,
            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class EmbeddingBuilder:\n\n    model_name = \"local-hash-v1\"\n    dimensions = 64\n\n    def build(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[float]:\n\n        vector = [0.0] * self.dimensions\n\n        for token in self._tokens(text):\n            digest = hashlib.sha256(\n                token.encode(\"utf-8\")\n            ).digest()\n            index = int.from_bytes(\n                digest[:2],\n                \"big\"\n            ) % self.dimensions\n            sign = 1.0 if digest[2] % 2 == 0 else -1.0\n            vector[index] += sign\n\n        norm = math.sqrt(\n            sum(value * value for value in vector)\n        )\n\n        if not norm:\n            return vector\n\n        return [\n            round(value / norm, 6)\n            for value in vector\n        ]\n\n    def content_hash(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> str:\n\n        return hashlib.sha256(\n            text.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        ).hexdigest()\n\n    def _tokens(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[str]:\n\n        return re.findall(\n            r\"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\",\n            text.lower()\n        )",

      "chunk_index": 0,
      "total_chunks": 1,
      "code": "class EmbeddingBuilder:\n\n    model_name = \"local-hash-v1\"\n    dimensions = 64\n\n    def build(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[float]:\n\n        vector = [0.0] * self.dimensions\n\n        for token in self._tokens(text):\n            digest = hashlib.sha256(\n                token.encode(\"utf-8\")\n            ).digest()\n            index = int.from_bytes(\n                digest[:2],\n                \"big\"\n            ) % self.dimensions\n            sign = 1.0 if digest[2] % 2 == 0 else -1.0\n            vector[index] += sign\n\n        norm = math.sqrt(\n            sum(value * value for value in vector)\n        )\n\n        if not norm:\n            return vector\n\n        return [\n            round(value / norm, 6)\n            for value in vector\n        ]\n\n    def content_hash(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> str:\n\n        return hashlib.sha256(\n            text.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        ).hexdigest()\n\n    def _tokens(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[str]:\n\n        return re.findall(\n            r\"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\",\n            text.lower()\n        )",

            "code": "class EmbeddingBuilder:\n\n    model_name = \"local-hash-v1\"\n    dimensions = 64\n\n    def build(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[float]:\n\n        vector = [0.0] * self.dimensions\n\n        for token in self._tokens(text):\n            digest = hashlib.sha256(\n                token.encode(\"utf-8\")\n            ).digest()\n            index = int.from_bytes(\n                digest[:2],\n                \"big\"\n            ) % self.dimensions\n            sign = 1.0 if digest[2] % 2 == 0 else -1.0\n            vector[index] += sign\n\n        norm = math.sqrt(\n            sum(value * value for value in vector)\n        )\n\n        if not norm:\n            return vector\n\n        return [\n            round(value / norm, 6)\n            for value in vector\n        ]\n\n    def content_hash(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> str:\n\n        return hashlib.sha256(\n            text.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        ).hexdigest()\n\n    def _tokens(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[str]:\n\n        return re.findall(\n            r\"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\",\n            text.lower()\n        )",

            "code": "class EmbeddingBuilder:\n\n    model_name = \"local-hash-v1\"\n    dimensions = 64\n\n    def build(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[float]:\n\n        vector = [0.0] * self.dimensions\n\n        for token in self._tokens(text):\n            digest = hashlib.sha256(\n                token.encode(\"utf-8\")\n            ).digest()\n            index = int.from_bytes(\n                digest[:2],\n                \"big\"\n            ) % self.dimensions\n            sign = 1.0 if digest[2] % 2 == 0 else -1.0\n            vector[index] += sign\n\n        norm = math.sqrt(\n            sum(value * value for value in vector)\n        )\n\n        if not norm:\n            return vector\n\n        return [\n            round(value / norm, 6)\n            for value in vector\n        ]\n\n    def content_hash(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> str:\n\n        return hashlib.sha256(\n            text.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        ).hexdigest()\n\n    def _tokens(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[str]:\n\n        return re.findall(\n            r\"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\",\n            text.lower()\n        )",

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class EmbeddingBuilder:\n\n    model_name = \"local-hash-v1\"\n    dimensions = 64\n\n    def build(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[float]:\n\n        vector = [0.0] * self.dimensions\n\n        for token in self._tokens(text):\n            digest = hashlib.sha256(\n                token.encode(\"utf-8\")\n            ).digest()\n            index = int.from_bytes(\n                digest[:2],\n                \"big\"\n            ) % self.dimensions\n            sign = 1.0 if digest[2] % 2 == 0 else -1.0\n            vector[index] += sign\n\n        norm = math.sqrt(\n            sum(value * value for value in vector)\n        )\n\n        if not norm:\n            return vector\n\n        return [\n            round(value / norm, 6)\n            for value in vector\n        ]\n\n    def content_hash(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> str:\n\n        return hashlib.sha256(\n            text.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        ).hexdigest()\n\n    def _tokens(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[str]:\n\n        return re.findall(\n            r\"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\",\n            text.lower()\n        )",

            "code": "class EmbeddingBuilder:\n\n    model_name = \"local-hash-v1\"\n    dimensions = 64\n\n    def build(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[float]:\n\n        vector = [0.0] * self.dimensions\n\n        for token in self._tokens(text):\n            digest = hashlib.sha256(\n                token.encode(\"utf-8\")\n            ).digest()\n            index = int.from_bytes(\n                digest[:2],\n                \"big\"\n            ) % self.dimensions\n            sign = 1.0 if digest[2] % 2 == 0 else -1.0\n            vector[index] += sign\n\n        norm = math.sqrt(\n            sum(value * value for value in vector)\n        )\n\n        if not norm:\n            return vector\n\n        return [\n            round(value / norm, 6)\n            for value in vector\n        ]\n\n    def content_hash(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> str:\n\n        return hashlib.sha256(\n            text.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        ).hexdigest()\n\n    def _tokens(\n        self,\n        text: str\n    ) -> list[str]:\n\n        return re.findall(\n            r\"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\",\n            text.lower()\n        )",

        "summary": "### Architecture Summary\n\n#### Overview\nThis frontend application is designed to manage user authentication and provide a structured query context for React applications. It includes components and providers that facilitate efficient data fetching and rendering.\n\n#### Core Components and Providers\n\n1. **Providers.tsx**\n   - **Role**: Provides essential context and wrappers (`QueryClientProvider`, `BrowserRouter`, `AuthProvider`) for the entire application.\n   - **Dependencies**:\n     - `@tanstack/react-query` for managing query state.\n     - `react-router-dom` for routing.\n     - Custom component: `AuthProvider`.\n\n2. **AuthProvider.tsx**\n   - **Role**: Manages authentication using Keycloak and provides context for accessing user authentication information across the application.\n   - **Dependencies**:\n     - React\n     - `keycloak-js`\n     - Custom functions from `./keycloak`\n\n3. **Separator.tsx**\n   - **Role**: A custom separator component for layout, utilizing Radix UI's `@radix-ui/react-separator`.\n   - **Dependencies**:\n     - React\n     - `cn` utility function from '@/lib/utils'\n\n#### Key Entry Points\n\n- **Providers.tsx (Entry Point)**: This file acts as the central hub of context and wraps the entire application, making it accessible to all child components.\n\n### Detailed Breakdown of Components\n\n1. **AppProviders.tsx**\n   - **Component Hierarchy**:\n     ```\n     AppProviders\n       ├── QueryClientProvider\n       │     └── BrowserRouter\n       │           └── AuthProvider\n       │                 ├── LoginForm\n       │                 ├── ProtectedRoute\n       │                 └── ...\n     ```\n   - **Functionality**:\n     - The `AppProviders` component provides the necessary context (`QueryClientProvider`, `BrowserRouter`, and `AuthProvider`) to its children.\n     - It ensures that all components can access query state, routing functionality, and authentication details.\n\n2. **AuthProvider.tsx**\n   - **Component Hierarchy**:\n     ```\n     AuthProvider\n       ├── KeycloakInstance\n       │     ├── useKeycloak\n       │           ├── LoginButton\n       │           └── ...\n       └── AuthContext\n             ├── isAuthenticated\n             ├── login\n             └── logout\n     ```\n   - **Functionality**:\n     - The `AuthProvider` component manages the authentication state using Keycloak.\n     - It provides a context (`AuthContext`) that allows components to access whether the user is authenticated, login/logout functions, and other related details.\n\n3. **Separator.tsx**\n   - **Component Hierarchy**:\n     ```\n     Separator\n       ├── RadixSeparator\n       │     └── cn utility function for styling\n     ```\n   - **Functionality**:\n     - The `Separator` component is a custom implementation using Radix UI's separator, providing a reusable and styled visual separator for layout.\n\n### Dependencies\n\n- **Libraries and Frameworks**:\n  - `@tanstack/react-query`: For managing query state in React applications.\n  - `react-router-dom`: For handling routing within the application.\n  - `keycloak-js`: For Keycloak authentication.\n  - `@radix-ui/react-separator`: For creating styled visual separators.\n\n- **Custom Functions and Modules**:\n  - Custom functions from `./keycloak` for managing Keycloak-related logic.\n  - Utility function (`cn`) from '@/lib/utils' for styling purposes.\n\n### Dependencies Summary\n\n- **Key External Libraries**: `@tanstack/react-query`, `react-router-dom`, `keycloak-js`, `@radix-ui/react-separator`.\n- **Custom Modules**: `./keycloak` (for Keycloak management), `'@/lib/utils'` (for utility functions).\n\n#### Summary\n\nThe frontend architecture is composed of three main components: `AppProviders`, `AuthProvider`, and `Separator`. These components provide a robust framework for handling query state, authentication, and layout. The dependencies include essential libraries such as React Router and Keycloak, along with custom modules for specific functionalities.         "summary": "### Architecture Summary\n\n#### Overview\nThis frontend application is designed to manage user authentication and provide a structured query context for React applications.         "summary": "### Architecture Summary\n\n#### Overview\nThis frontend application is designed to manage user authentication and provide a structured query context for React applications. It includes components and providers that facilitate efficient data fetching and rendering.\n\n#### Core Components and Providers\n\n1. **Providers.tsx**\n   - **Role**: Provides essential context and wrappers (`QueryClientProvider`, `BrowserRouter`, `AuthProvider`) for the entire application.\n   - **Dependencies**:\n     - `@tanstack/react-query` for managing query state.\n     - `react-router-dom` for routing.\n     - Custom component: `AuthProvider`.\n\n2. **AuthProvider.tsx**\n   - **Role**: Manages authentication using Keycloak and provides context for accessing user authentication information across the application.\n   - **Dependencies**:\n     - React\n     - `keycloak-js`\n     - Custom functions from `./keycloak`\n\n3. **Separator.tsx**\n   - **Role**: A custom separator component for layout, utilizing Radix UI's `@radix-ui/react-separator`.\n   - **Dependencies**:\n     - React\n     - `cn` utility function from '@/lib/utils'\n\n#### Key Entry Points\n\n- **Providers.tsx (Entry Point)**: This file acts as the central hub of context and wraps the entire application, making it accessible to all child components.\n\n### Detailed Breakdown of Components\n\n1. **AppProviders.tsx**\n   - **Component Hierarchy**:\n     ```\n     AppProviders\n       ├── QueryClientProvider\n       │     └── BrowserRouter\n       │           └── AuthProvider\n       │                 ├── LoginForm\n       │                 ├── ProtectedRoute\n       │                 └── ...\n     ```\n   - **Functionality**:\n     - The `AppProviders` component provides the necessary context (`QueryClientProvider`, `BrowserRouter`, and `AuthProvider`) to its children.\n     - It ensures that all components can access query state, routing functionality, and authentication details.\n\n2. **AuthProvider.tsx**\n   - **Component Hierarchy**:\n     ```\n     AuthProvider\n       ├── KeycloakInstance\n       │     ├── useKeycloak\n       │           ├── LoginButton\n       │           └── ...\n       └── AuthContext\n             ├── isAuthenticated\n             ├── login\n             └── logout\n     ```\n   - **Functionality**:\n     - The `AuthProvider` component manages the authentication state using Keycloak.\n     - It provides a context (`AuthContext`) that allows components to access whether the user is authenticated, login/logout functions, and other related details.\n\n3. **Separator.tsx**\n   - **Component Hierarchy**:\n     ```\n     Separator\n       ├── RadixSeparator\n       │     └── cn utility function for styling\n     ```\n   - **Functionality**:\n     - The `Separator` component is a custom implementation using Radix UI's separator, providing a reusable and styled visual separator for layout.\n\n### Dependencies\n\n- **Libraries and Frameworks**:\n  - `@tanstack/react-query`: For managing query state in React applications.\n  - `react-router-dom`: For handling routing within the application.\n  - `keycloak-js`: For Keycloak authentication.\n  - `@radix-ui/react-separator`: For creating styled visual separators.\n\n- **Custom Functions and Modules**:\n  - Custom functions from `./keycloak` for managing Keycloak-related logic.\n  - Utility function (`cn`) from '@/lib/utils' for styling purposes.\n\n### Dependencies Summary\n\n- **Key External Libraries**: `@tanstack/react-query`, `react-router-dom`, `keycloak-js`, `@radix-ui/react-separator`.\n- **Custom Modules**: `./keycloak` (for Keycloak management), `'@/lib/utils'` (for utility functions).\n\n#### Summary\n\nThe frontend architecture is composed of three main components: `AppProviders`, `AuthProvider`, and `Separator`. These components provide a robust framework for handling query state, authentication, and layout. The dependencies include essential libraries such as React Router and Keycloak, along with custom modules for specific functionalities.           "frontend\\.env.local": "### Summary of frontend\\.env.local\n\n#### Architecture\nThe `frontend\\.env.local` file is a configuration file used in a frontend project that likely utilizes Vite as its build tool.           "frontend\\vite.config.ts": "### Summary of `frontend\\vite.config.ts`\n\n#### Architecture\nThe configuration file is written in TypeScript and uses the Vite build tool.           "frontend\\src\\lib\\roles.ts": "### Summary of `frontend\\src\\lib\\roles.ts`\n\n#### Architecture and Imports:\n- The file defines a role management system using constants for role names.\n- It exports types and functions related to user roles.\n\n#### Export Symbols:\n1. **Constants**:\n   - Logic:\n     - Converts `userRoles` into a `Set` for efficient lookup.\n     - Returns `true` if all roles in `required` exist in the user's roles set.\n\n#### Role in the System:\n- **Role Management**: The file provides a centralized way to manage and check user roles, ensuring consistency and ease of maintenance.\n- **Authorization Checks**: The `hasAnyRole` and `hasAllRoles` functions are useful for implementing authorization logic, determining if a user has the necessary permissions to perform certain actions based on their role.\n\n### Example Usage:\n```typescript\nimport { Roles, hasAnyRole, hasAllRoles } from './lib/roles';\n\nconst userRoles = ['MANAGER', 'EMPLOYEE'];\n\n// Check if the user has any of the required roles\nconst hasAny = hasAnyRole(userRoles, [Roles.MANAGER, Roles.PROJECT_MANAGER]); // true\n\n// Check if the user has all the required roles\nconst hasAll = hasAllRoles(userRoles, [Roles.MANAGER, Roles.EMPLOYEE]); // true\n```\n\nThis file serves as a foundational component for role-based access control in the application, ensuring that permissions are correctly enforced based on user roles.",

          "frontend\\.env.example": "### Summary of `frontend\\.env.example`\n\nThe file `frontend\\.env.example` is a configuration file used in a frontend application, likely built with a framework like Vite. This file provides environment-specific variables that are required for the application to function correctly. Below is a breakdown of its content:\n\n#### Architecture\n- **Environment Variables**: The file contains environment variables that start with `VITE_`, which are intended to be accessed by the frontend code using Vite's import mechanism.\n\n#### Imports/Export Symbols\n- **No Explicit Imports or Exports**: This file does not define any JavaScript modules, functions, or classes that need to be imported or exported. It is a plain text file containing key-value pairs for configuration settings.\n\n#### Main Functions\n- **No Main Functions**: The file itself does not contain any code or functions that perform operations. Instead, it serves as a template for setting up environment-specific variables.\n\n#### Role in the System\n- **Configuration Management**: This file is used to manage configuration variables that are specific to different environments (development, testing, production). By using `VITE_` prefix, these variables can be accessed in the frontend code via the `import.meta.env` object.\n  - **Example Usage**:\n    ```javascript\n    // Accessing Keycloak URL in JavaScript/TypeScript\n    const keycloakUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_KEYCLOAK_URL;\n    ```\n- **Local Development**: The file suggests copying it to `.env.local` for local development, where developers can override default settings without affecting the main configuration.\n  - **Example**:\n    ```plaintext\n    # .env.local\n    VITE_KEYCLOAK_URL=http://localhost:8081\n    VITE_KEYCLOAK_REALM=hrms\n    VITE_KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID=hrms-frontend\n    VITE_API_BASE_URL=\n    ```\n- **API Base URL**: The file allows for the API base URL to be specified, which defaults to the same-origin `/api` if left empty. This is typically configured by a proxy in the development environment.\n  - **Example**:\n    ```javascript\n    // Accessing API Base URL in JavaScript/TypeScript\n    const apiUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '/api';\n    ```\n\n### Summary\n- **Purpose**: To provide environment-specific configuration variables for a frontend application built with Vite.\n- **Usage**: Developers can copy this file to `.env.local` and modify it as needed for their local development environment.\n- **Environment Variables**: Primarily contains settings like Keycloak URL, realm, client ID, and API base URL.\n- **Role**: Facilitates configuration management and allows for easy switching between different environments.",
          "frontend\\.env.local": "### Summary of frontend\\.env.local\n\n#### Architecture\nThe `frontend\\.env.local` file is a configuration file used in a frontend project that likely utilizes Vite as its build tool. It contains environment-specific variables that are essential for the application's operation, particularly those related to API integration and Keycloak authentication.\n\n#### Imports\nThis file does not contain any explicit import statements because it is a `.env` file used by Vite. However, it sets up global variables that can be accessed throughout the project using `import.meta.env`.\n\n#### Export Symbols\nThe environment variables defined in this file are exported implicitly through the process of declaring them with the prefix `VITE_`. This makes them accessible globally within the application as properties on `import.meta.env`, such as:\n- `import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL`\n- `import.meta.env.VITE_KEYCLOAK_URL`\n- `import.meta.env.VITE_KEYCLOAK_REALM`\n- `import.meta.env.VITE_KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID`\n\n#### Main Functions\nThis file does not contain any functions. It is purely a configuration file used to set environment-specific variables.\n\n#### Role in the System\nThe role of this file is crucial for configuring the frontend application's interaction with its backend API and Keycloak authentication system. Here’s how it impacts the system:\n1. **API Integration**: The `VITE_API_BASE_URL` is used to specify the base URL for all API requests, ensuring that the frontend knows where to make HTTP calls.\n2. **Keycloak Authentication**: \n   - `VITE_KEYCLOAK_URL`: Specifies the Keycloak server's URL.\n   - `VITE_KEYCLOAK_REALM`: Indicates which Keycloak realm (or organization) the application should authenticate against.\n   - `VITE_KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID`: Identifies the client (usually a frontend application) within the Keycloak realm.\n\nThese variables are essential for ensuring that the frontend can communicate securely and effectively with its backend services using Keycloak for authentication.\n\nIn summary, the `frontend\\.env.local` file is a configuration file in a Vite-based frontend project. It sets up environment-specific variables used for API integration and Keycloak authentication, which are crucial for the application's functionality.",
          "frontend\\vite.config.ts": "### Summary of `frontend\\vite.config.ts`\n\n#### Architecture\nThe configuration file is written in TypeScript and uses the Vite build tool. It defines a Vite project's configuration for building a React frontend application.\n\n#### Imports\n- **`tailwindcss`**: A plugin to integrate Tailwind CSS into the Vite build process.\n- **`react`**: A Vite plugin specifically for React applications.\n- **`path`** and **`fileURLToPath`**: Node.js modules used for path manipulation and converting file URLs to paths, respectively.\n- **`defineConfig`**: A function from Vite to define the configuration object.\n\n#### Export Symbols\n- **`default`: `defineConfig({ ... })`**: The default export is a configuration object that sets up the plugins, aliases, and server settings for the Vite project.\n\n#### Main Functions\n1. **`tailwindcss()`**:\n   - Integrates Tailwind CSS into the Vite build process to allow using utility-first classes in styles.\n   \n2. **`react()`**:\n   - Configures Vite to handle React components, including JSX and TypeScript types for React elements.\n\n3. **`path.resolve(__dirname, './src')`**:\n   - Resolves the absolute path to the `src` directory relative to the current file's location.\n\n4. **`Number(process.env.FRONTEND_PORT ?? 5173)`**:\n   - Determines the port number for the development server using an environment variable, defaulting to `5173`.\n\n5. **`process.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL ?? 'http://localhost:8080'`**:\n   - Sets the base URL for API requests from environment variables or defaults to `http://localhost:8080`.\n\n#### Role in the System\n- **Plugins**: The configuration enables support for React and Tailwind CSS, which are essential for building a modern frontend application.\n- **Aliases**: It sets up an alias (`@`) that points to the `src` directory, making it easier to import modules without specifying their full path.\n- **Server Configuration**: It configures the development server to run on a specified port and proxy API requests to a backend service. This is particularly useful during development for connecting frontend code to a backend running on a different port.\n\nThis configuration file is crucial for setting up the development environment for a React application using Vite, ensuring that all necessary tools and settings are in place for efficient development.",
          "frontend\\src\\lib\\roles.ts": "### Summary of `frontend\\src\\lib\\roles.ts`\n\n#### Architecture and Imports:\n- The file defines a role management system using constants for role names.\n- It exports types and functions related to user roles.\n\n#### Export Symbols:\n1. **Constants**:\n   - `Roles`: An object containing predefined role identifiers.\n   \n2. **Types**:\n   - `Role`: A type alias representing one of the roles from the `Roles` constant.\n   \n3. **Functions**:\n   - `hasAnyRole(userRoles: string[], required: Role[]): boolean`: Checks if any of the user's roles match the required roles.\n   - `hasAllRoles(userRoles: string[], required: Role[]): boolean`: Checks if all of the user's roles match the required roles.\n\n#### Main Functions:\n1. **`hasAnyRole`**:\n   - Parameters:\n     - `userRoles`: An array of strings representing the user's roles.\n     - `required`: An array of `Role` types representing the required roles.\n   - Logic:\n     - If `required` is empty, it returns `true`.\n     - Converts `userRoles` into a `Set` for efficient lookup.\n     - Returns `true` if any role in `required` exists in the user's roles set.\n\n2. **`hasAllRoles`**:\n   - Parameters:\n     - `userRoles`: An array of strings representing the user's roles.\n     - `required`: An array of `Role` types representing the required roles.\n   - Logic:\n     - Converts `userRoles` into a `Set` for efficient lookup.\n     - Returns `true` if all roles in `required` exist in the user's roles set.\n\n#### Role in the System:\n- **Role Management**: The file provides a centralized way to manage and check user roles, ensuring consistency and ease of maintenance.\n- **Authorization Checks**: The `hasAnyRole` and `hasAllRoles` functions are useful for implementing authorization logic, determining if a user has the necessary permissions to perform certain actions based on their role.\n\n### Example Usage:\n```typescript\nimport { Roles, hasAnyRole, hasAllRoles } from './lib/roles';\n\nconst userRoles = ['MANAGER', 'EMPLOYEE'];\n\n// Check if the user has any of the required roles\nconst hasAny = hasAnyRole(userRoles, [Roles.MANAGER, Roles.PROJECT_MANAGER]); // true\n\n// Check if the user has all the required roles\nconst hasAll = hasAllRoles(userRoles, [Roles.MANAGER, Roles.EMPLOYEE]); // true\n```\n\nThis file serves as a foundational component for role-based access control in the application, ensuring that permissions are correctly enforced based on user roles.",

It is purely a configuration file used to set environment-specific variables.\n\n#### Role in the System\nThe role of this file is crucial for configuring the frontend application's interaction with its backend API and Keycloak authentication system. actorLabel: string | null; action: string; entity: string; entityId: string | null; requestId: string | null; detail: string | null };\n\nexport const operationsApi = {\n  salaryMe: () => api.get<Salary[]>('/api/salaries/me'),\n  salaryForEmployee: (employeeId: string) => api.get<Salary[]>(`/api/salaries/employee/${employeeId}`),\n  createSalary: (body: { employeeId: string;             "chunk_index": 1,
            "total_chunks": 2,
            "code": "\n    @PostMapping\n    @PreAuthorize(\"hasAnyRole('\" + Roles.SUPER_ADMIN + \"','\" + Roles.HR_ADMIN + \"')\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Create an employee (HR / SUPER only)\")\n    public ResponseEntity<EmployeeResponse> create(@RequestBody @Valid EmployeeCreateRequest request) {\n        EmployeeResponse created = service.create(request);\n        return ResponseEntity\n                .created(URI.create(\"/api/employees/\" + created.id()))\n                .body(created);\n    }\n\n    @PutMapping(\"/{id}\")\n    @PreAuthorize(\"hasAnyRole('\" + Roles.SUPER_ADMIN + \"','\" + Roles.HR_ADMIN + \"')\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Update an employee's HR fields (HR / SUPER only)\")\n    public EmployeeResponse update(@PathVariable UUID id,\n                                   @RequestBody @Valid EmployeeUpdateRequest request) {\n        return service.update(id, request);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Self-service contact info update. EMPLOYEE may update their own;\n     * HR/SUPER may update anyone's. The service layer enforces the\n     * \"self-only\" rule for EMPLOYEE callers — endpoint-level\n     * {@code @PreAuthorize} only screens the role membership.\n     */\n    @PatchMapping(\"/{id}/contact\")\n    @PreAuthorize(\"hasAnyRole('\"\n            + Roles.SUPER_ADMIN + \"','\"\n            + Roles.HR_ADMIN + \"','\"\n            + Roles.EMPLOYEE + \"')\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Update contact info (self for EMPLOYEE, anyone for HR/SUPER)\")\n    public EmployeeResponse updateContact(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt,\n                                          @PathVariable UUID id,\n                                          @RequestBody @Valid EmployeeContactUpdateRequest request) {\n        return service.updateContact(CurrentUser.from(jwt), id, request);\n    }\n\n    @DeleteMapping(\"/{id}\")\n    @PreAuthorize(\"hasAnyRole('\" + Roles.SUPER_ADMIN + \"','\" + Roles.HR_ADMIN + \"')\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Soft-delete an employee record\")\n    public ResponseEntity<Void> softDelete(@PathVariable UUID id) {\n        service.softDelete(id);\n        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();\n    }\n\n    @DeleteMapping(\"/{id}/permanent\")\n    @PreAuthorize(\"hasRole('\" + Roles.SUPER_ADMIN + \"')\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Hard-delete an employee record (SUPER_ADMIN only). \"\n            + \"Reserved for legal / compliance erasure; audited as HARD_DELETE.\")\n    public ResponseEntity<Void> hardDelete(@PathVariable UUID id) {\n        service.hardDelete(id);\n        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();\n    }\n}"
          }

            "code": "package com.acme.hrms.employee.dto;\n\nimport java.time.LocalDate;\nimport java.util.UUID;\n\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.Email;\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank;\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull;\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.Past;\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.PastOrPresent;\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.Pattern;\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.Size;\n\nimport com.acme.hrms.employee.entity.EmploymentStatus;\n\npublic record EmployeeCreateRequest(\n        @NotBlank @Size(max = 32) String employeeCode,\n        @NotBlank @Size(max = 64) String firstName,\n        @NotBlank @Size(max = 64) String lastName,\n        @NotBlank @Email @Size(max = 254) String email,\n        @Size(max = 32)\n        @Pattern(regexp = \"^[+0-9 ()-]*$\", message = \"phone number contains invalid characters\")\n        String phoneNumber,\n        @Past LocalDate dateOfBirth,\n        @NotNull @PastOrPresent LocalDate dateOfJoining,\n        EmploymentStatus employmentStatus,\n        UUID keycloakUserId,\n        UUID departmentId,\n        UUID designationId,\n        UUID locationId,\n        UUID managerId\n) {\n}"
          }
        },

            "code": "import { api } from '@/lib/api/client';\nimport type { SpringPage } from '@/lib/api/types';\n\nexport type Salary = { id: string; employeeId: string; amount: number; currencyCode: string; effectiveFrom: string; effectiveTo: string | null; reason: string | null; createdAt: string };\nexport type DocumentRecord = { id: string; employeeId: string; documentType: string; restricted: boolean; sharable: boolean; originalFilename: string; contentType: string; sizeBytes: number | null; uploadStatus: string; createdAt: string };\nexport type AuditEntry = { id: string; at: string; actorId: string | null; actorLabel: string | null; action: string; entity: string; entityId: string | null; requestId: string | null; detail: string | null };\n\nexport const operationsApi = {\n  salaryMe: () => api.get<Salary[]>('/api/salaries/me'),\n  salaryForEmployee: (employeeId: string) => api.get<Salary[]>(`/api/salaries/employee/${employeeId}`),\n  createSalary: (body: { employeeId: string; amount: number; currencyCode: string; effectiveFrom: string; effectiveTo?: string; reason?: string }) => api.post<Salary>('/api/salaries', body),\n\n  documentsForEmployee: (employeeId: string) => api.get<DocumentRecord[]>(`/api/documents/employee/${employeeId}`),\n  presignUpload: (body: { employeeId: string; documentType: string; contentType: string; originalFilename: string; sharable: boolean }) => api.post<{ documentId: string; uploadUrl: string; httpMethod: string; storageKey: string }>('/api/documents/presign-upload', body),\n  completeUpload: (documentId: string, sizeBytes: number) => api.post<DocumentRecord>(`/api/documents/${documentId}/complete`, { sizeBytes }),\n  presignDownload: (documentId: string) => api.get<{ documentId: string; downloadUrl: string; httpMethod: string }>(`/api/documents/${documentId}/presign-download`),\n  deleteDocument: (documentId: string) => api.delete<void>(`/api/documents/${documentId}`),\n\n  auditLogs: (page: number, size: number) => api.get<SpringPage<AuditEntry>>(`/api/audit-logs?page=${page}&size=${size}&sort=at,desc`),\n};"
          }
        }
      ],

      "code": "package com.acme.hrms.employee.dto;\n\nimport java.time.LocalDate;\nimport java.util.UUID;\n\nimport com.acme.hrms.employee.entity.EmploymentStatus;\n\nimport io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;\n\n/**\n * Public-ish view of an employee used in list endpoints.\n *\n * <p>Per architecture §3.4 (defense-in-depth field redaction), list views\n * intentionally omit fields that aren't safe for every authorised reader:\n * date of birth, phone number, manager id (org chart), salary (lives in\n * its own module). The full {@link EmployeeResponse} returns those\n * conditionally based on the caller's role and self-flag.\n */\n@Schema(description = \"List-view employee record. Omits sensitive personal \"\n        + \"details — see EmployeeResponse for the full read.\")\npublic record EmployeeSummary(\n        UUID id,\n        String employeeCode,\n        String firstName,\n        String lastName,\n        String email,\n        UUID departmentId,\n        String departmentName,\n        UUID designationId,\n        String designationTitle,\n        UUID locationId,\n        String locationName,\n        LocalDate dateOfJoining,\n        EmploymentStatus employmentStatus\n) {\n}"
    },

      "chunk_index": 0,
      "total_chunks": 1,
      "code": "import { api } from '@/lib/api/client';\nimport type { SpringPage } from '@/lib/api/types';\n\nexport type Salary = { id: string; employeeId: string; amount: number; currencyCode: string; effectiveFrom: string; effectiveTo: string | null; reason: string | null; createdAt: string };\nexport type DocumentRecord = { id: string; employeeId: string; documentType: string; restricted: boolean; sharable: boolean; originalFilename: string; contentType: string; sizeBytes: number | null; uploadStatus: string; createdAt: string };\nexport type AuditEntry = { id: string; at: string; actorId: string | null; actorLabel: string | null; action: string; entity: string; entityId: string | null; requestId: string | null; detail: string | null };\n\nexport const operationsApi = {\n  salaryMe: () => api.get<Salary[]>('/api/salaries/me'),\n  salaryForEmployee: (employeeId: string) => api.get<Salary[]>(`/api/salaries/employee/${employeeId}`),\n  createSalary: (body: { employeeId: string; amount: number; currencyCode: string; effectiveFrom: string; effectiveTo?: string; reason?: string }) => api.post<Salary>('/api/salaries', body),\n\n  documentsForEmployee: (employeeId: string) => api.get<DocumentRecord[]>(`/api/documents/employee/${employeeId}`),\n  presignUpload: (body: { employeeId: string; documentType: string; contentType: string; originalFilename: string; sharable: boolean }) => api.post<{ documentId: string; uploadUrl: string; httpMethod: string; storageKey: string }>('/api/documents/presign-upload', body),\n  completeUpload: (documentId: string, sizeBytes: number) => api.post<DocumentRecord>(`/api/documents/${documentId}/complete`, { sizeBytes }),\n  presignDownload: (documentId: string) => api.get<{ documentId: string; downloadUrl: string; httpMethod: string }>(`/api/documents/${documentId}/presign-download`),\n  deleteDocument: (documentId: string) => api.delete<void>(`/api/documents/${documentId}`),\n\n  auditLogs: (page: number, size: number) => api.get<SpringPage<AuditEntry>>(`/api/audit-logs?page=${page}&size=${size}&sort=at,desc`),\n};"
    },

      "chunk_index": 1,
      "total_chunks": 2,
      "code": "\n    @PostMapping\n    @PreAuthorize(\"hasAnyRole('\" + Roles.SUPER_ADMIN + \"','\" + Roles.HR_ADMIN + \"')\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Create an employee (HR / SUPER only)\")\n    public ResponseEntity<EmployeeResponse> create(@RequestBody @Valid EmployeeCreateRequest request) {\n        EmployeeResponse created = service.create(request);\n        return ResponseEntity\n                .created(URI.create(\"/api/employees/\" + created.id()))\n                .body(created);\n    }\n\n    @PutMapping(\"/{id}\")\n    @PreAuthorize(\"hasAnyRole('\" + Roles.SUPER_ADMIN + \"','\" + Roles.HR_ADMIN + \"')\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Update an employee's HR fields (HR / SUPER only)\")\n    public EmployeeResponse update(@PathVariable UUID id,\n                                   @RequestBody @Valid EmployeeUpdateRequest request) {\n        return service.update(id, request);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Self-service contact info update. EMPLOYEE may update their own;\n     * HR/SUPER may update anyone's. The service layer enforces the\n     * \"self-only\" rule for EMPLOYEE callers — endpoint-level\n     * {@code @PreAuthorize} only screens the role membership.\n     */\n    @PatchMapping(\"/{id}/contact\")\n    @PreAuthorize(\"hasAnyRole('\"\n            + Roles.SUPER_ADMIN + \"','\"\n            + Roles.HR_ADMIN + \"','\"\n            + Roles.EMPLOYEE + \"')\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Update contact info (self for EMPLOYEE, anyone for HR/SUPER)\")\n    public EmployeeResponse updateContact(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt,\n                                          @PathVariable UUID id,\n                                          @RequestBody @Valid EmployeeContactUpdateRequest request) {\n        return service.updateContact(CurrentUser.from(jwt), id, request);\n    }\n\n    @DeleteMapping(\"/{id}\")\n    @PreAuthorize(\"hasAnyRole('\" + Roles.SUPER_ADMIN + \"','\" + Roles.HR_ADMIN + \"')\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Soft-delete an employee record\")\n    public ResponseEntity<Void> softDelete(@PathVariable UUID id) {\n        service.softDelete(id);\n        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();\n    }\n\n    @DeleteMapping(\"/{id}/permanent\")\n    @PreAuthorize(\"hasRole('\" + Roles.SUPER_ADMIN + \"')\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Hard-delete an employee record (SUPER_ADMIN only). \"\n            + \"Reserved for legal / compliance erasure; audited as HARD_DELETE.\")\n    public ResponseEntity<Void> hardDelete(@PathVariable UUID id) {\n        service.hardDelete(id);\n        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();\n    }\n}"

            "chunk_index": 1,
            "total_chunks": 2,
            "code": "\n    @PostMapping\n    @PreAuthorize(\"hasAnyRole('\" + Roles.SUPER_ADMIN + \"','\" + Roles.HR_ADMIN + \"')\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Create an employee (HR / SUPER only)\")\n    public ResponseEntity<EmployeeResponse> create(@RequestBody @Valid EmployeeCreateRequest request) {\n        EmployeeResponse created = service.create(request);\n        return ResponseEntity\n                .created(URI.create(\"/api/employees/\" + created.id()))\n                .body(created);\n    }\n\n    @PutMapping(\"/{id}\")\n    @PreAuthorize(\"hasAnyRole('\" + Roles.SUPER_ADMIN + \"','\" + Roles.HR_ADMIN + \"')\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Update an employee's HR fields (HR / SUPER only)\")\n    public EmployeeResponse update(@PathVariable UUID id,\n                                   @RequestBody @Valid EmployeeUpdateRequest request) {\n        return service.update(id, request);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Self-service contact info update. EMPLOYEE may update their own;\n     * HR/SUPER may update anyone's. The service layer enforces the\n     * \"self-only\" rule for EMPLOYEE callers — endpoint-level\n     * {@code @PreAuthorize} only screens the role membership.\n     */\n    @PatchMapping(\"/{id}/contact\")\n    @PreAuthorize(\"hasAnyRole('\"\n            + Roles.SUPER_ADMIN + \"','\"\n            + Roles.HR_ADMIN + \"','\"\n            + Roles.EMPLOYEE + \"')\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Update contact info (self for EMPLOYEE, anyone for HR/SUPER)\")\n    public EmployeeResponse updateContact(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt,\n                                          @PathVariable UUID id,\n                                          @RequestBody @Valid EmployeeContactUpdateRequest request) {\n        return service.updateContact(CurrentUser.from(jwt), id, request);\n    }\n\n    @DeleteMapping(\"/{id}\")\n    @PreAuthorize(\"hasAnyRole('\" + Roles.SUPER_ADMIN + \"','\" + Roles.HR_ADMIN + \"')\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Soft-delete an employee record\")\n    public ResponseEntity<Void> softDelete(@PathVariable UUID id) {\n        service.softDelete(id);\n        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();\n    }\n\n    @DeleteMapping(\"/{id}/permanent\")\n    @PreAuthorize(\"hasRole('\" + Roles.SUPER_ADMIN + \"')\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Hard-delete an employee record (SUPER_ADMIN only). \"\n            + \"Reserved for legal / compliance erasure; audited as HARD_DELETE.\")\n    public ResponseEntity<Void> hardDelete(@PathVariable UUID id) {\n        service.hardDelete(id);\n        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();\n    }\n}"
          }

            "code": "\n    @PostMapping\n    @PreAuthorize(\"hasAnyRole('\" + Roles.SUPER_ADMIN + \"','\" + Roles.HR_ADMIN + \"')\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Create an employee (HR / SUPER only)\")\n    public ResponseEntity<EmployeeResponse> create(@RequestBody @Valid EmployeeCreateRequest request) {\n        EmployeeResponse created = service.create(request);\n        return ResponseEntity\n                .created(URI.create(\"/api/employees/\" + created.id()))\n                .body(created);\n    }\n\n    @PutMapping(\"/{id}\")\n    @PreAuthorize(\"hasAnyRole('\" + Roles.SUPER_ADMIN + \"','\" + Roles.HR_ADMIN + \"')\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Update an employee's HR fields (HR / SUPER only)\")\n    public EmployeeResponse update(@PathVariable UUID id,\n                                   @RequestBody @Valid EmployeeUpdateRequest request) {\n        return service.update(id, request);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Self-service contact info update. EMPLOYEE may update their own;\n     * HR/SUPER may update anyone's. The service layer enforces the\n     * \"self-only\" rule for EMPLOYEE callers — endpoint-level\n     * {@code @PreAuthorize} only screens the role membership.\n     */\n    @PatchMapping(\"/{id}/contact\")\n    @PreAuthorize(\"hasAnyRole('\"\n            + Roles.SUPER_ADMIN + \"','\"\n            + Roles.HR_ADMIN + \"','\"\n            + Roles.EMPLOYEE + \"')\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Update contact info (self for EMPLOYEE, anyone for HR/SUPER)\")\n    public EmployeeResponse updateContact(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt,\n                                          @PathVariable UUID id,\n                                          @RequestBody @Valid EmployeeContactUpdateRequest request) {\n        return service.updateContact(CurrentUser.from(jwt), id, request);\n    }\n\n    @DeleteMapping(\"/{id}\")\n    @PreAuthorize(\"hasAnyRole('\" + Roles.SUPER_ADMIN + \"','\" + Roles.HR_ADMIN + \"')\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Soft-delete an employee record\")\n    public ResponseEntity<Void> softDelete(@PathVariable UUID id) {\n        service.softDelete(id);\n        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();\n    }\n\n    @DeleteMapping(\"/{id}/permanent\")\n    @PreAuthorize(\"hasRole('\" + Roles.SUPER_ADMIN + \"')\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Hard-delete an employee record (SUPER_ADMIN only). \"\n            + \"Reserved for legal / compliance erasure; audited as HARD_DELETE.\")\n    public ResponseEntity<Void> hardDelete(@PathVariable UUID id) {\n        service.hardDelete(id);\n        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();\n    }\n}"
          }
        },

            "code": "package com.acme.hrms.employee.dto;\n\nimport java.time.LocalDate;\nimport java.util.UUID;\n\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.Email;\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank;\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull;\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.Past;\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.PastOrPresent;\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.Pattern;\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.Size;\n\nimport com.acme.hrms.employee.entity.EmploymentStatus;\n\npublic record EmployeeCreateRequest(\n        @NotBlank @Size(max = 32) String employeeCode,\n        @NotBlank @Size(max = 64) String firstName,\n        @NotBlank @Size(max = 64) String lastName,\n        @NotBlank @Email @Size(max = 254) String email,\n        @Size(max = 32)\n        @Pattern(regexp = \"^[+0-9 ()-]*$\", message = \"phone number contains invalid characters\")\n        String phoneNumber,\n        @Past LocalDate dateOfBirth,\n        @NotNull @PastOrPresent LocalDate dateOfJoining,\n        EmploymentStatus employmentStatus,\n        UUID keycloakUserId,\n        UUID departmentId,\n        UUID designationId,\n        UUID locationId,\n        UUID managerId\n) {\n}"

            "code": "import { api } from '@/lib/api/client';\nimport type { SpringPage } from '@/lib/api/types';\n\nexport type Salary = { id: string; employeeId: string; amount: number; currencyCode: string; effectiveFrom: string; effectiveTo: string | null; reason: string | null; createdAt: string };\nexport type DocumentRecord = { id: string; employeeId: string; documentType: string; restricted: boolean; sharable: boolean; originalFilename: string; contentType: string; sizeBytes: number | null; uploadStatus: string; createdAt: string };\nexport type AuditEntry = { id: string; at: string; actorId: string | null; actorLabel: string | null; action: string; entity: string; entityId: string | null; requestId: string | null; detail: string | null };\n\nexport const operationsApi = {\n  salaryMe: () => api.get<Salary[]>('/api/salaries/me'),\n  salaryForEmployee: (employeeId: string) => api.get<Salary[]>(`/api/salaries/employee/${employeeId}`),\n  createSalary: (body: { employeeId: string; amount: number; currencyCode: string; effectiveFrom: string; effectiveTo?: string; reason?: string }) => api.post<Salary>('/api/salaries', body),\n\n  documentsForEmployee: (employeeId: string) => api.get<DocumentRecord[]>(`/api/documents/employee/${employeeId}`),\n  presignUpload: (body: { employeeId: string; documentType: string; contentType: string; originalFilename: string; sharable: boolean }) => api.post<{ documentId: string; uploadUrl: string; httpMethod: string; storageKey: string }>('/api/documents/presign-upload', body),\n  completeUpload: (documentId: string, sizeBytes: number) => api.post<DocumentRecord>(`/api/documents/${documentId}/complete`, { sizeBytes }),\n  presignDownload: (documentId: string) => api.get<{ documentId: string; downloadUrl: string; httpMethod: string }>(`/api/documents/${documentId}/presign-download`),\n  deleteDocument: (documentId: string) => api.delete<void>(`/api/documents/${documentId}`),\n\n  auditLogs: (page: number, size: number) => api.get<SpringPage<AuditEntry>>(`/api/audit-logs?page=${page}&size=${size}&sort=at,desc`),\n};"
          }
        }

      "docstring": "* Public-ish view of an employee used in list endpoints.\n *\n * <p>Per architecture §3.4 (defense-in-depth field redaction), list views\n * intentionally omit fields that aren't safe for every authorised reader:\n * date of birth, phone number, manager id (org chart), salary (lives in\n * its own module). The full {@link EmployeeResponse} returns those\n * conditionally based on the caller's role and self-flag.",
      "imports": [
        "io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema",

      ],
      "chunk_index": 0,
      "total_chunks": 1,
      "code": "package com.acme.hrms.employee.dto;\n\nimport java.time.LocalDate;\nimport java.util.UUID;\n\nimport com.acme.hrms.employee.entity.EmploymentStatus;\n\nimport io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;\n\n/**\n * Public-ish view of an employee used in list endpoints.\n *\n * <p>Per architecture §3.4 (defense-in-depth field redaction), list views\n * intentionally omit fields that aren't safe for every authorised reader:\n * date of birth, phone number, manager id (org chart), salary (lives in\n * its own module). The full {@link EmployeeResponse} returns those\n * conditionally based on the caller's role and self-flag.\n */\n@Schema(description = \"List-view employee record. Omits sensitive personal \"\n        + \"details — see EmployeeResponse for the full read.\")\npublic record EmployeeSummary(\n        UUID id,\n        String employeeCode,\n        String firstName,\n        String lastName,\n        String email,\n        UUID departmentId,\n        String departmentName,\n        UUID designationId,\n        String designationTitle,\n        UUID locationId,\n        String locationName,\n        LocalDate dateOfJoining,\n        EmploymentStatus employmentStatus\n) {\n}"
    },
    {

      "type": "FunctionDef",

      "start_line": 1,
      "end_line": 20,
      "parent": null,
      "docstring": "",
      "imports": [
        "@/lib/api/types",
        "@/lib/api/client"
      ],
      "chunk_index": 0,
      "total_chunks": 1,
      "code": "import { api } from '@/lib/api/client';\nimport type { SpringPage } from '@/lib/api/types';\n\nexport type Salary = { id: string; employeeId: string; amount: number; currencyCode: string; effectiveFrom: string; effectiveTo: string | null; reason: string | null; createdAt: string };\nexport type DocumentRecord = { id: string; employeeId: string; documentType: string; restricted: boolean; sharable: boolean; originalFilename: string; contentType: string; sizeBytes: number | null; uploadStatus: string; createdAt: string };\nexport type AuditEntry = { id: string; at: string; actorId: string | null; actorLabel: string | null; action: string; entity: string; entityId: string | null; requestId: string | null; detail: string | null };\n\nexport const operationsApi = {\n  salaryMe: () => api.get<Salary[]>('/api/salaries/me'),\n  salaryForEmployee: (employeeId: string) => api.get<Salary[]>(`/api/salaries/employee/${employeeId}`),\n  createSalary: (body: { employeeId: string; amount: number; currencyCode: string; effectiveFrom: string; effectiveTo?: string; reason?: string }) => api.post<Salary>('/api/salaries', body),\n\n  documentsForEmployee: (employeeId: string) => api.get<DocumentRecord[]>(`/api/documents/employee/${employeeId}`),\n  presignUpload: (body: { employeeId: string; documentType: string; contentType: string; originalFilename: string; sharable: boolean }) => api.post<{ documentId: string; uploadUrl: string; httpMethod: string; storageKey: string }>('/api/documents/presign-upload', body),\n  completeUpload: (documentId: string, sizeBytes: number) => api.post<DocumentRecord>(`/api/documents/${documentId}/complete`, { sizeBytes }),\n  presignDownload: (documentId: string) => api.get<{ documentId: string; downloadUrl: string; httpMethod: string }>(`/api/documents/${documentId}/presign-download`),\n  deleteDocument: (documentId: string) => api.delete<void>(`/api/documents/${documentId}`),\n\n  auditLogs: (page: number, size: number) => api.get<SpringPage<AuditEntry>>(`/api/audit-logs?page=${page}&size=${size}&sort=at,desc`),\n};"
    },

      "code": "\n    @PostMapping\n    @PreAuthorize(\"hasAnyRole('\" + Roles.SUPER_ADMIN + \"','\" + Roles.HR_ADMIN + \"')\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Create an employee (HR / SUPER only)\")\n    public ResponseEntity<EmployeeResponse> create(@RequestBody @Valid EmployeeCreateRequest request) {\n        EmployeeResponse created = service.create(request);\n        return ResponseEntity\n                .created(URI.create(\"/api/employees/\" + created.id()))\n                .body(created);\n    }\n\n    @PutMapping(\"/{id}\")\n    @PreAuthorize(\"hasAnyRole('\" + Roles.SUPER_ADMIN + \"','\" + Roles.HR_ADMIN + \"')\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Update an employee's HR fields (HR / SUPER only)\")\n    public EmployeeResponse update(@PathVariable UUID id,\n                                   @RequestBody @Valid EmployeeUpdateRequest request) {\n        return service.update(id, request);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Self-service contact info update.             "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }
        },
