            "code": "    def _summarise_failures(self, failures: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Short human-readable summary of failures for action titles.\"\"\"\n        parts = []\n        for f in failures[:3]:\n            error_type = f.get(\"error_type\", \"\")\n            message = f.get(\"message\", \"\")\n            if error_type and message:\n                parts.append(f\"{error_type}: {message[:60]}\")\n            elif message:\n                parts.append(message[:60])\n        return \"; \".join(parts) if parts else \"test failure\""

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }
        },

      "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
    },

      "total_chunks": 1,
      "code": "    def _summarise_failures(self, failures: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Short human-readable summary of failures for action titles.\"\"\"\n        parts = []\n        for f in failures[:3]:\n            error_type = f.get(\"error_type\", \"\")\n            message = f.get(\"message\", \"\")\n            if error_type and message:\n                parts.append(f\"{error_type}: {message[:60]}\")\n            elif message:\n                parts.append(message[:60])\n        return \"; \".join(parts) if parts else \"test failure\""
    },

            "code": "    def _summarise_failures(self, failures: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Short human-readable summary of failures for action titles.\"\"\"\n        parts = []\n        for f in failures[:3]:\n            error_type = f.get(\"error_type\", \"\")\n            message = f.get(\"message\", \"\")\n            if error_type and message:\n                parts.append(f\"{error_type}: {message[:60]}\")\n            elif message:\n                parts.append(message[:60])\n        return \"; \".join(parts) if parts else \"test failure\""
          }

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }
        },

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }
        },

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }
        },

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }
        },

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }
        },

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }

            "code": "    def _summarise_failures(self, failures: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Short human-readable summary of failures for action titles.\"\"\"\n        parts = []\n        for f in failures[:3]:\n            error_type = f.get(\"error_type\", \"\")\n            message = f.get(\"message\", \"\")\n            if error_type and message:\n                parts.append(f\"{error_type}: {message[:60]}\")\n            elif message:\n                parts.append(message[:60])\n        return \"; \".join(parts) if parts else \"test failure\""
          }

            "code": "    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])"

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }
        },

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }

            "code": "    def _summarise_failures(self, failures: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Short human-readable summary of failures for action titles.\"\"\"\n        parts = []\n        for f in failures[:3]:\n            error_type = f.get(\"error_type\", \"\")\n            message = f.get(\"message\", \"\")\n            if error_type and message:\n                parts.append(f\"{error_type}: {message[:60]}\")\n            elif message:\n                parts.append(message[:60])\n        return \"; \".join(parts) if parts else \"test failure\""

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }
        },

            "code": "    def _summarise_failures(self, failures: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Short human-readable summary of failures for action titles.\"\"\"\n        parts = []\n        for f in failures[:3]:\n            error_type = f.get(\"error_type\", \"\")\n            message = f.get(\"message\", \"\")\n            if error_type and message:\n                parts.append(f\"{error_type}: {message[:60]}\")\n            elif message:\n                parts.append(message[:60])\n        return \"; \".join(parts) if parts else \"test failure\""

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }

      "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
    },

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }
        },

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }
        },

            "total_chunks": 1,
            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }
        },

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }
        },

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }
        },

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }

            "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)"
          }
        },

      "chunk_index": 0,
      "total_chunks": 1,
      "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",
      "_ranking_diagnostics": {

      "chunk_index": 0,
      "total_chunks": 1,
      "code": "    def _summarise_failures(self, failures: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Short human-readable summary of failures for action titles.\"\"\"\n        parts = []\n        for f in failures[:3]:\n            error_type = f.get(\"error_type\", \"\")\n            message = f.get(\"message\", \"\")\n            if error_type and message:\n                parts.append(f\"{error_type}: {message[:60]}\")\n            elif message:\n                parts.append(message[:60])\n        return \"; \".join(parts) if parts else \"test failure\"",

      "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

      "chunk_index": 0,
      "total_chunks": 1,
      "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

      "code": "    def _summarise_failures(self, failures: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Short human-readable summary of failures for action titles.\"\"\"\n        parts = []\n        for f in failures[:3]:\n            error_type = f.get(\"error_type\", \"\")\n            message = f.get(\"message\", \"\")\n            if error_type and message:\n                parts.append(f\"{error_type}: {message[:60]}\")\n            elif message:\n                parts.append(message[:60])\n        return \"; \".join(parts) if parts else \"test failure\"",

      "total_chunks": 1,
      "code": "class RepoContext:\n\n    IMPORTANT_FILES = [\n        \"pom.xml\",\n        \"package.json\",\n        \"README.md\"\n    ]\n\n    IGNORE_DIRS = {\n        \"node_modules\",\n        \".git\",\n        \"__pycache__\",\n        \".venv\",\n        \"venv\",\n        \"dist\",\n        \"build\"\n    }\n\n    IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".png\",\n        \".jpg\",\n        \".jpeg\",\n        \".gif\",\n        \".exe\",\n        \".lock\"\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, root=\".\"):\n\n        self.root = Path(root)\n\n    def summarize(self, files):\n\n        important = []\n\n        for file in files:\n\n            # Ignore unwanted folders\n            if any(ignore in file for ignore in self.IGNORE_DIRS):\n                continue\n\n            # Ignore unwanted file types\n            if any(file.endswith(ext) for ext in self.IGNORE_EXTENSIONS):\n                continue\n\n            important.append(file)\n\n        important.sort()\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(important[:200])\n\n    def build_summary(self):\n\n        summary = []\n\n        for file in self.IMPORTANT_FILES:\n\n            path = self.root / file\n\n            if path.exists():\n\n                content = path.read_text(\n                    encoding=\"utf-8\",\n                    errors=\"ignore\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    f\"\\nFILE: {file}\\n\"\n                )\n\n                summary.append(\n                    content[:3000]\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(summary)",

      "code": "-- =============================================================================\n-- Salary history (append-only, effective-dated).\n-- =============================================================================\n\nCREATE TABLE salary_history (\n    id             uuid           PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),\n    employee_id    uuid           NOT NULL REFERENCES employee(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,\n    amount         numeric(18,4)  NOT NULL,\n    currency_code  varchar(3)     NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR',\n    effective_from date           NOT NULL,\n    effective_to   date           NULL,\n    reason         text           NULL,\n    created_at     timestamptz    NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),\n    created_by     uuid           NULL,\n    updated_at     timestamptz    NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),\n    updated_by     uuid           NULL,\n    deleted_at     timestamptz    NULL,\n    version        bigint         NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n    CONSTRAINT ck_salary_amount_positive CHECK (amount > 0),\n    CONSTRAINT ck_salary_currency_len CHECK (char_length(currency_code) = 3),\n    CONSTRAINT ck_salary_date_range CHECK (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= effective_from)\n);\n\nCREATE INDEX ix_salary_history_employee\n    ON salary_history (employee_id, effective_from DESC)\n    WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;"

org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;\nimport org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;\nimport org.springframework.security.core.annotation.AuthenticationPrincipal;\nimport org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;\n\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.security.CurrentUser;\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.security.Roles;\nimport com.acme.hrms.salary.dto.SalaryCreateRequest;\nimport com.acme.hrms.salary.dto.SalaryResponse;\nimport com.acme.hrms.salary.service.SalaryService;\n\nimport io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;\nimport io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;\n\n@RestController\n@RequestMapping(\"/api/salaries\")\n@Tag(name = \"Salaries\")\npublic class SalaryController {\n\n    private final SalaryService service;\n\n    public SalaryController(SalaryService service) {\n        this.service = service;\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping(\"/me\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Read own salary history\")\n    public List<SalaryResponse> me(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {\n        return service.listForSelf(CurrentUser.from(jwt));\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping(\"/employee/{employeeId}\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Read salary history for a specific employee\")\n    public List<SalaryResponse> byEmployee(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt,\n                                           @PathVariable UUID employeeId) {\n        return service.listForEmployee(CurrentUser.from(jwt), employeeId);\n    }\n\n    @PostMapping\n    @PreAuthorize(\"hasAnyRole('\"\n            + Roles.SUPER_ADMIN + \"','\"\n            + Roles.HR_ADMIN + \"','\"\n            + Roles.FINANCE_ADMIN + \"')\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Create a salary history record\")\n    public ResponseEntity<SalaryResponse> create(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt,\n                                                 @RequestBody @Valid SalaryCreateRequest request) {\n        SalaryResponse created = service.create(CurrentUser.from(jwt), request);\n        return ResponseEntity\n                .created(URI.create(\"/api/salaries/\" + created.id()))\n                .body(created);\n    }\n}"

      "code": "package com.acme.hrms.salary.service;\n\nimport java.time.LocalDate;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.UUID;\n\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Service;\nimport org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;\n\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.audit.AuditAction;\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.audit.AuditEvent;\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.audit.AuditService;\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.error.ConflictException;\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.error.ForbiddenAccessException;\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.error.NotFoundException;\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.security.CurrentUser;\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.security.Roles;\nimport com.acme.hrms.employee.entity.Employee;\nimport com.acme.hrms.employee.repository.EmployeeRepository;\nimport com.acme.hrms.salary.dto.SalaryCreateRequest;\nimport com.acme.hrms.salary.dto.SalaryResponse;\nimport com.acme.hrms.salary.entity.SalaryHistory;\nimport com.acme.hrms.salary.repository.SalaryHistoryRepository;\n\n@Service\npublic class SalaryServiceImpl implements SalaryService {\n\n    private static final String ENTITY = \"salary_history\";\n    private static final LocalDate INFINITY_DATE = LocalDate.of(9999, 12, 31);\n\n    private final SalaryHistoryRepository salaries;\n    private final EmployeeRepository employees;\n    private final AuditService auditService;\n\n    public SalaryServiceImpl(SalaryHistoryRepository salaries,\n                             EmployeeRepository employees,\n                             AuditService auditService) {\n        this.salaries = salaries;\n        this.employees = employees;\n        this.auditService = auditService;\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    @Transactional(readOnly = true)\n    public List<SalaryResponse> listForSelf(CurrentUser user) {\n        Employee self = loadEmployeeBySubject(user.subjectUuid());\n        auditService.record(AuditEvent.of(AuditAction.READ_SENSITIVE, ENTITY)\n                .withEntityId(self.getId())\n                .withDetail(\"self salary history read\"));\n        return       "code": "-- =============================================================================\n-- Salary history (append-only, effective-dated).\n-- =============================================================================\n\nCREATE TABLE salary_history (\n    id             uuid           PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),\n    employee_id    uuid           NOT NULL REFERENCES employee(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,\n    amount         numeric(18,4)  NOT NULL,\n    currency_code  varchar(3)     NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR',\n    effective_from date           NOT NULL,\n    effective_to   date           NULL,\n    reason         text           NULL,\n    created_at     timestamptz    NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),\n    created_by     uuid           NULL,\n    updated_at     timestamptz    NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),\n    updated_by     uuid           NULL,\n    deleted_at     timestamptz    NULL,\n    version        bigint         NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n    CONSTRAINT ck_salary_amount_positive CHECK (amount > 0),\n    CONSTRAINT ck_salary_currency_len CHECK (char_length(currency_code) = 3),\n    CONSTRAINT ck_salary_date_range CHECK (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= effective_from)\n);\n\nCREATE INDEX ix_salary_history_employee\n    ON salary_history (employee_id, effective_from DESC)\n    WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;"

      "code": "package com.acme.hrms.salary.controller;\n\nimport java.net.URI;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.UUID;\n\nimport jakarta.validation.Valid;\n\nimport org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;\nimport org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;\nimport org.springframework.security.core.annotation.AuthenticationPrincipal;\nimport org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;\n\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.security.CurrentUser;\nimport com.acme.hrms.common.security.Roles;\nimport com.acme.hrms.salary.dto.SalaryCreateRequest;\nimport com.acme.hrms.salary.dto.SalaryResponse;\nimport com.acme.hrms.salary.service.SalaryService;\n\nimport io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;\nimport io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;\n\n@RestController\n@RequestMapping(\"/api/salaries\")\n@Tag(name = \"Salaries\")\npublic class SalaryController {\n\n    private final SalaryService service;\n\n    public SalaryController(SalaryService service) {\n        this.service = service;\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping(\"/me\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Read own salary history\")\n    public List<SalaryResponse> me(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {\n        return service.listForSelf(CurrentUser.from(jwt));\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping(\"/employee/{employeeId}\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Read salary history for a specific employee\")\n    public List<SalaryResponse> byEmployee(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt,\n                                           @PathVariable UUID employeeId) {\n        return service.listForEmployee(CurrentUser.from(jwt), employeeId);\n    }\n\n    @PostMapping\n    @PreAuthorize(\"hasAnyRole('\"\n            + Roles.SUPER_ADMIN + \"','\"\n            + Roles.HR_ADMIN + \"','\"\n            + Roles.FINANCE_ADMIN + \"')\")\n    @Operation(summary = \"Create a salary history record\")\n    public ResponseEntity<SalaryResponse> create(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt,\n                                                 @RequestBody @Valid SalaryCreateRequest request) {\n        SalaryResponse created = service.create(CurrentUser.from(jwt), request);\n        return ResponseEntity\n                .created(URI.create(\"/api/salaries/\" + created.id()))\n                .body(created);\n    }\n}"

@Override\n    @Transactional(readOnly = true)\n    public List<SalaryResponse> listForSelf(CurrentUser user) {\n        Employee self = loadEmployeeBySubject(user.subjectUuid());\n
